    <script>
        const API = '../php-crud/dashboardCRD.php';
        let financialChart = null;
        let doughnutChart = null;
        let ratesCache = [];

        // ---------- helpers ----------
        const nf = (n, d = 2) => Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: d, maximumFractionDigits: d });
        const rp = n => 'Rp ' + nf(n, 2);
        const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
        const projectId = () => document.getElementById('select-project').value || 0;

        async function api(params) {
            const r = await fetch(API + '?' + new URLSearchParams(params));
            const txt = await r.text();
            try { return JSON.parse(txt); }
            catch (e) { console.error('Respons bukan JSON:', txt); return { success: false, message: 'Respons server tidak valid (cek error_log PHP).' }; }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            initFinancialChart();
            initDoughnutChart();
            loadTaxRates();
            reloadFinancialChart();
            loadMonitoring();
            startLive();
        });

        function onProjectChange() {
            const id = projectId();
            history.replaceState(null, '', id > 0 ? '?project_id=' + id : location.pathname);
            reloadFinancialChart();
            loadMonitoring();
        }

        // ---------- 1. KURS PAJAK (GRID) ----------
        async function loadTaxRates() {
            const res = await api({ action: 'read_tax_rates' });
            if (!res.success) {
                document.getElementById('rates-container').innerHTML =
                    `<tr><td colspan="5" class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-rose-400">${esc(res.message)}</td></tr>`;
                return;
            }
            document.getElementById('kmk-number').innerText = res.kmk_number;
            document.getElementById('kmk-start-date').innerText = res.start_date;
            document.getElementById('kmk-end-date').innerText = res.end_date;
            ratesCache = res.rates || [];
            renderRates();
        }

        function renderRates() {
            const q = (document.getElementById('rate-search').value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            const list = ratesCache.filter(i => !q || (i.currency_code + ' ' + i.currency_name).toLowerCase().includes(q));
            const box = document.getElementById('rates-container');

            if (!list.length) {
                box.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="5" class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-slate-500">${
                    ratesCache.length ? 'Mata uang tidak ditemukan.' : "Tidak ada data kurs pajak. Klik 'Update Kurs Bea Cukai'."}</td></tr>`;
                return;
            }

            box.innerHTML = list.map(i => {
                const mult = Number(i.unit_multiplier || 1);
                const amt = Math.abs(Number(i.change_amount || 0));
                const dir = String(i.change_direction || '').toLowerCase();
                let state = 'stay';
                if (amt !== 0) {
                    state = (dir.startsWith('down') || dir === '-') ? 'down' : 'up';
                }
                const cfg = {
                    up:   { txt: 'text-emerald-400', sign: '+', badge: 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300', icon: 'fa-arrow-up',   label: 'UP' },
                    down: { txt: 'text-rose-400',    sign: '-', badge: 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-300',       icon: 'fa-arrow-down', label: 'DOWN' },
                    stay: { txt: 'text-slate-500',   sign: '+', badge: 'bg-slate-500/15 text-slate-400',     icon: 'fa-minus',      label: 'STAY' }
                }[state];

                return `
                <tr class="hover:bg-[#0b2236]/70 transition-colors">
                    <td class="px-4 py-2.5 font-bold text-sky-400">${esc(i.currency_code)}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-200">${esc(i.currency_name)}${mult !== 1 ? ` <span class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">(per ${mult})</span>` : ''}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-2.5 text-right font-mono text-slate-100">Rp ${nf(i.rate, 2)}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-2.5 text-right font-mono ${cfg.txt}">${cfg.sign}${nf(amt, 2)}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-2.5 text-center">
                        <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold ${cfg.badge}">
                            <i class="fa-solid ${cfg.icon} text-[8px]"></i> ${cfg.label}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                </tr>`;
            }).join('');
        }

        async function updateRatesFromBeaCukai() {
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-update-kurs');
            const icon = document.getElementById('icon-sync');
            btn.disabled = true;
            icon.classList.add('fa-spin');
            const res = await api({ action: 'sync_tax_rates' });
            btn.disabled = false;
            icon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
            alert(res.message || (res.success ? 'Data Kurs Pajak berhasil diperbarui!' : 'Gagal mengambil data dari server Bea Cukai'));
            loadTaxRates();
        }

        // ---------- 2. PERFORMA KEUANGAN ----------
        const compact = v => {
            const a = Math.abs(v);
            if (a >= 1e9) return (v / 1e9).toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' M';
            if (a >= 1e6) return (v / 1e6).toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' jt';
            if (a >= 1e3) return (v / 1e3).toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' rb';
            return v;
        };

        function initFinancialChart() {
            financialChart = new Chart(document.getElementById('chartFinancial').getContext('2d'), {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Agu', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des'],
                    datasets: [
                        { label: 'Pendapatan',  data: [], borderColor: '#00c3ff', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,195,255,0.1)',  fill: true, tension: 0.3 },
                        { label: 'Pengeluaran', data: [], borderColor: '#a855f7', backgroundColor: 'rgba(168,85,247,0.1)', fill: true, tension: 0.3 }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                    scales: {
                        x: { grid: { color: '#1a3a52' }, ticks: { color: '#94a3b8' } },
                        y: { grid: { color: '#1a3a52' }, ticks: { color: '#94a3b8', callback: compact }, beginAtZero: true }
                    },
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { labels: { color: '#cbd5e1' } },
                        tooltip: { callbacks: { label: c => ` ${c.dataset.label}: ${rp(c.parsed.y)}` } }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        async function reloadFinancialChart() {
            const yr = document.getElementById('select-year').value;
            const msg = document.getElementById('fin-msg');
            msg.classList.add('hidden');

            const res = await api({ action: 'read_financial_performance', project_id: projectId(), year: yr });
            if (!res.success) {
                msg.textContent = res.message;
                msg.classList.remove('hidden');
                return;
            }
            financialChart.data.datasets[0].data = res.datasets.pendapatan;
            financialChart.data.datasets[1].data = res.datasets.pengeluaran;
            financialChart.update();

            const total = [...res.datasets.pendapatan, ...res.datasets.pengeluaran].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
            if (total === 0) {
                msg.textContent = 'Belum ada transaksi pendapatan/pengeluaran pada tahun ' + yr + ' untuk pilihan proyek ini.';
                msg.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        }

        // ---------- 3. MONITORING MATERIAL (KPI + DOUGHNUT + TABEL) ----------
        function initDoughnutChart() {
            doughnutChart = new Chart(document.getElementById('doughnutChart').getContext('2d'), {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: { labels: ['Kosong'], datasets: [{ data: [1], backgroundColor: ['#1a3a52'], borderColor: '#091a29', borderWidth: 3 }] },
                options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '65%', plugins: { legend: { labels: { color: '#cbd5e1' } } } }
            });
        }

        function updateDoughnut(c) {
            const total = c.ON_TRACK + c.WARNING + c.OVERBUDGET;
            const ds = doughnutChart.data.datasets[0];
            if (total === 0) {
                doughnutChart.data.labels = ['Kosong'];
                ds.data = [1];
                ds.backgroundColor = ['#1a3a52'];
            } else {
                doughnutChart.data.labels = ['On Track', 'Warning', 'Overbudget'];
                ds.data = [c.ON_TRACK, c.WARNING, c.OVERBUDGET];
                ds.backgroundColor = ['#0ea5e9', '#f59e0b', '#f43f5e'];
            }
            doughnutChart.update();
        }

        async function loadMonitoring(silent = false) {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('material-tbody');
            if (!silent) {
                tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" class="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 italic">Memuat data...</td></tr>';
            }

            const res = await api({ action: 'read_material_monitoring', project_id: projectId() });
            if (!res.success) {
                tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="6" class="p-8 text-center text-rose-400">${esc(res.message)}</td></tr>`;
                return;
            }

            const k = res.kpi;
            document.getElementById('kpi-budget').textContent = rp(k.budget_rab);
            document.getElementById('kpi-out').textContent = rp(k.material_out);
            document.getElementById('kpi-out-note').textContent = res.cost_estimated
                ? 'Sebagian biaya diestimasi (unit_cost material out = 0)'
                : 'Total pengeluaran material ke lapangan';
            const sisa = document.getElementById('kpi-sisa');
            sisa.textContent = rp(k.sisa_budget);
            sisa.className = 'text-2xl font-bold mt-1 ' + (k.sisa_budget < 0 ? 'text-rose-400' : 'text-sky-300');
            document.getElementById('kpi-pct').textContent = nf(k.persentase, 2) + '%';
            document.getElementById('table-caption').textContent =
                projectId() > 0 ? 'Filtered by Selected Project' : 'Semua Proyek';

            updateDoughnut(res.status_counts);

            if (!res.items.length) {
                tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" class="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 italic">Belum ada data transaksi material out atau budget RAB untuk proyek yang dipilih.</td></tr>';
                return;
            }

            const badge = {
                OVERBUDGET: 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/40',
                WARNING:    'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40',
                ON_TRACK:   'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/40'
            };

            tbody.innerHTML = res.items.map(i => `
                <tr class="hover:bg-[#06131d]/50 transition-colors">
                    <td class="p-3">
                        <div class="font-bold text-white">${esc(i.item_name)}</div>
                        <div class="text-[10px] text-cyan-500">${esc(i.item_code) || '-'}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-right font-mono text-cyan-200">
                        ${nf(i.budget_qty)} ${esc(i.unit)}
                        <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">${rp(i.budget_value)}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-right font-mono text-emerald-400">
                        ${nf(i.out_qty)} ${esc(i.unit)}
                        <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">${rp(i.out_value)}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-right font-mono ${i.remaining_qty < 0 ? 'text-rose-400' : 'text-slate-300'}">${nf(i.remaining_qty)} ${esc(i.unit)}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-center font-bold text-cyan-300">${i.no_rab ? '<span class="text-slate-500">Tanpa RAB</span>' : nf(i.usage_pct, 1) + '%'}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-center">
                        <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold rounded-full border ${badge[i.status]}">${esc(i.status)}</span>
                    </td>
                </tr>`).join('');
        }

        // ---------- 4. LIVE UPDATE ----------
        // Polling ringan ke live_stamp. Begitu ada transaksi RCV / issue / retur / keuangan / RAB
        // (stamp berubah), semua widget dihitung ulang tanpa reload halaman.
        const LIVE_MS = 4000;
        let liveStamp = null, liveOn = true, refreshing = false;

        function setLive(state, time) {
            const dot = document.getElementById('live-dot');
            const lbl = document.getElementById('live-label');
            const cls = { ok: 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse', error: 'bg-rose-500', off: 'bg-slate-500', busy: 'bg-cyan-400 animate-ping' };
            dot.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full ' + (cls[state] || cls.off);
            lbl.textContent = state === 'off' ? 'PAUSED' : (state === 'error' ? 'OFFLINE' : 'LIVE');
            if (time) document.getElementById('live-time').textContent = time;
        }

        async function refreshAll() {
            if (refreshing) return;
            refreshing = true;
            const icon = document.getElementById('icon-refresh');
            icon.classList.add('fa-spin');
            try {
                await Promise.all([reloadFinancialChart(), loadMonitoring(true)]);
            } finally {
                refreshing = false;
                icon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
            }
        }

        async function pollLive() {
            if (!liveOn || document.hidden || refreshing) return;
            const res = await api({ action: 'live_stamp' });
            if (!res.success) { setLive('error'); return; }
            const changed = liveStamp !== null && res.stamp !== liveStamp;
            liveStamp = res.stamp;
            setLive('ok', res.server_time);
            if (changed) await refreshAll();
        }

        function toggleLive() {
            liveOn = !liveOn;
            setLive(liveOn ? 'ok' : 'off');
            if (liveOn) pollLive();
        }

        function startLive() {
            pollLive();
            setInterval(pollLive, LIVE_MS);
            // kembali ke tab ini -> cek langsung
            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (!document.hidden) pollLive(); });
            // halaman Warehouse Issuing (tab lain) memberi sinyal instan setelah post/reverse
            try { new BroadcastChannel('ixyz-txn').onmessage = () => refreshAll(); } catch (e) {}
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

## File: ./php-class/excelClass.php
----------------------------------------
<?php

/**
 * Simple excel writer class with no external dependencies, drop it in and have fun
 * @author Matt Nowack
 * @link https://gist.github.com/ihumanable/929039/edit
 * @license Unlicensed
 * @version 1.0
 */
class Excel {
  private $col;
  private $row;
  private $data;
  private $title;
  
  /**
   * Safely encode a string for use as a filename
   * @param string $title The title to use for the file
   * @return string The file safe title
   */
  static function filename($title) {
    $result = strtolower(trim($title));
    $result = str_replace("'", '', $result);
    $result = preg_replace('#[^a-z0-9_]+#', '-', $result);
    $result = preg_replace('#\-{2,}#', '-', $result);
    return preg_replace('#(^\-+|\-+$)#D', '', $result);
  }
  
  /**
   * Builds a new Excel Spreadsheet object
   * @return Excel The Spreadsheet
   */
  function __construct($title) {
    $this->title = $title;
    $this->col = 0;
    $this->row = 0;
    $this->data = '';
    $this->bofMarker();
  }
  
  /**
   * Transmits the proper headers to cause a download to occur and to identify the file properly
   * @return nothing
   */
  function headers() {
    header("Content-Type: application/force-download");
    header("Content-Type: application/octet-stream");
    header("Content-Type: application/download");
    header("Content-Disposition: attachment;filename=" . Excel::filename($this->title) . ".xls ");
    header("Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary ");
  }
  
  function send() {
    $this->eofMarker();
    $this->headers();
    echo $this->data;
  }
  
  /**
   * Writes the Excel Beginning of File marker
   * @see pack()
   * @return nothing
   */
  private function bofMarker() { 
    $this->data .= pack("ssssss", 0x809, 0x8, 0x0, 0x10, 0x0, 0x0);  
  }
  
  /**
   * Writes the Excel End of File marker
   * @see pack()
   * @return nothing
   */
  private function eofMarker() { 
    $this->data .= pack("ss", 0x0A, 0x00); 
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor left by the amount specified
   * @param optional integer $amount The amount to move left by, defaults to 1
   * @return integer The current column after the move
   */
  function left($amount = 1) {
    $this->col -= $amount;
    if($this->col < 0) {
      $this->col = 0;
    }
    return $this->col;
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor right by the amount specified
   * @param optional integer $amount The amount to move right by, defaults to 1
   * @return integer The current column after the move
   */
  function right($amount = 1) {
    $this->col += $amount;
    return $this->col;
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor up by amount
   * @param optional integer $amount The amount to move up by, defaults to 1
   * @return integer The current row after the move
   */  
  function up($amount = 1) {
    $this->row -= $amount;
    if($this->row < 0) {
      $this->row = 0;
    }
    return $this->row;
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor down by amount
   * @param optional integer $amount The amount to move down by, defaults to 1
   * @return integer The current row after the move
   */
  function down($amount = 1) {
    $this->row += $amount;
    return $this->row;
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor to the top of the page, row = 0
   * @return nothing
   */
  function top() {
    $this->row = 0;
  }
  
  /**
   * Moves internal cursor all the way left, col = 0
   * @return nothing
   */
  function home() {
    $this->col = 0;
  }
  
  /**
   * Writes a number to the Excel Spreadsheet
   * @see pack()
   * @param integer $value The value to write out
   * @return nothing
   */
  function number($value) { 
    $this->data .= pack("sssss", 0x203, 14, $this->row, $this->col, 0x0); 
    $this->data .= pack("d", $value); 
  }
  
  /**
   * Writes a string (or label) to the Excel Spreadsheet
   * @see pack()
   * @param string $value The value to write out
   * @return nothing
   */
  function label($value) { 
    $length = strlen($value);
    $this->data .= pack("ssssss", 0x204, 8 + $length, $this->row, $this->col, 0x0, $length); 
    $this->data .= $value; 
  }
}

## File: ./php-class/crudClass.php
----------------------------------------
<?php
if (!isset($_SESSION)) {
    session_start();
}
date_default_timezone_set('Asia/Jakarta');

error_reporting(E_ALL & ~E_NOTICE & ~E_DEPRECATED);
$wwwdoc = $_SERVER["DOCUMENT_ROOT"];

if (file_exists("../php-func/function.all.php")) {
    include_once "../php-func/function.all.php";
}

if (!class_exists('crud')) {

  class crud extends PDO {
    private $engine;
    private $host;
    private $database;
    private $user;
    private $pass;
    private $result;

    public $status;
    public $success;
    public $message;

    public function __construct() {
      $this->engine   = 'pgsql';
      $this->host     = "127.0.0.1";
      $this->database = "proyekGMN";
      $this->user     = "postgres";
      $this->pass     = ""; // Sesuaikan password database Anda

      $dns = $this->engine . ':dbname=' . $this->database . ";port=5432;host=" . $this->host;

      try {
          parent::__construct($dns, $this->user, $this->pass);
          $this->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

          // PERBAIKAN WARNING: Gunakan SET (Session level) alih-alih SET LOCAL (Transaction level)
          $appUser = $_SESSION['login_name'] ?? $_SESSION['username'] ?? 'system';
          $this->exec("SET app.username = " . $this->quote($appUser));
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
          echo "Koneksi Gagal: " . $e->getMessage();
          exit;
      }
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan kueri SELECT
     *
     * PERBAIKAN: sebelumnya method ini menangkap PDOException sendiri dan
     * hanya `return false`, sehingga kegagalan query (mis. kolom tidak ada,
     * tabel salah nama, dsb) jadi SENYAP kalau pemanggil tidak mengecek
     * return value-nya. Padahal koneksi PDO ini sudah di-set
     * PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION di constructor -- niatnya memang supaya error
     * langsung ketahuan. Sekarang exception dilempar ulang (rethrow) setelah
     * detailnya tetap disimpan ke $this->result/getResult() untuk kompatibilitas
     * kode lama yang membaca itu.
     */
    public function setAppUser($username = null) {
        if (!$username) {
            $username = $_SESSION['login_name'] ?? $_SESSION['username'] ?? 'system';
        }
        // Menggunakan PDO exec / prepare
        $stmt = $this->prepare("SELECT set_config('app.username', :user, true)");
        $stmt->execute(['user' => $username]);
    }
    public function select($table, $rows = "*", $where = null, $order = null, $limit = null, $offset = null, $group = null) {
      try {
        $q = "SELECT " . $rows . " FROM " . $table;

        if ($where != null) { $q .= " WHERE " . $where; }
        if ($group != null) { $q .= " GROUP BY " . $group; }
        if ($order != null) { $q .= " ORDER BY " . $order; }
        if ($limit != null) { $q .= " LIMIT " . intval($limit); }
        if ($offset != null) { $q .= " OFFSET " . intval($offset); }

        $query = $this->prepare($q);
        $query->execute();

        $data = $query->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $output = array(
            "success"    => "true",
            "status"     => "Success",
            "totalCount" => count($data),
            "data"       => $data
        );

        $this->result = json_encode($output);
        return true;

      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $errorResult = array(
            "success" => "false",
            "status"  => "Error",
            "message" => "Query Select Gagal: " . $e->getMessage()
        );
        $this->result = json_encode($errorResult);
        throw $e; // <-- rethrow, jangan ditelan
      }
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan kueri INSERT
     * (lihat catatan PERBAIKAN di select() -- sama: rethrow, bukan return false)
     */
    public function insert($table, $data) {
      try {
        $keys = array_keys($data);
        $fields = implode(", ", $keys);
        $placeholders = ":" . implode(", :", $keys);

        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$table} ({$fields}) VALUES ({$placeholders})";

        $stmt = $this->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($data);

        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"]  = "Success";
        $result["message"] = "Data berhasil ditambahkan.";
        $this->result      = json_encode($result);
        return true;
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $errorResult = array(
            "success" => "false",
            "status"  => "Error",
            "message" => "Query Insert Gagal (" . $table . "): " . $e->getMessage()
        );
        $this->result = json_encode($errorResult);
        throw $e; // <-- rethrow, jangan ditelan
      }
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan kueri UPDATE secara presisi
     * (lihat catatan PERBAIKAN di select() -- sama: rethrow, bukan return false)
     */
    public function update($table, $data, $where) {
      try {
        $fields = "";
        $params = [];

        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            $fields .= "{$key} = :{$key}, ";

            // PERBAIKAN BOOLEAN & NULL: Penanganan eksplisit tipe data PDO
            if (is_bool($value)) {
                $params[":{$key}"] = $value ? 'true' : 'false';
            } else {
                $params[":{$key}"] = $value;
            }
        }
        $fields = rtrim($fields, ', ');

        $sql = "UPDATE {$table} SET {$fields} WHERE {$where}";

        $stmt = $this->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"]  = "Success";
        $result["message"] = "Data berhasil diperbarui.";
        $this->result      = json_encode($result);
        return true;
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $errorResult = array(
            "success" => "false",
            "status"  => "Error",
            "message" => "Query Update Gagal (" . $table . "): " . $e->getMessage()
        );
        $this->result = json_encode($errorResult);
        throw $e; // <-- rethrow, jangan ditelan
      }
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan kueri DELETE
     * (lihat catatan PERBAIKAN di select() -- sama: rethrow, bukan return false)
     */
    public function delete($table, $where) {
      try {
        $sql = "DELETE FROM {$table} WHERE {$where}";

        $stmt = $this->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute();

        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"]  = "Success";
        $result["message"] = "Data berhasil dihapus.";
        $this->result      = json_encode($result);
        return true;
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        $errorResult = array(
            "success" => "false",
            "status"  => "Error",
            "message" => "Query Delete Gagal (" . $table . "): " . $e->getMessage()
        );
        $this->result = json_encode($errorResult);
        throw $e; // <-- rethrow, jangan ditelan
      }
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan perintah SQL bebas (DDL/DML tanpa binding)
     *
     * cmdQ() TIDAK di-rethrow seperti method di atas, karena beberapa
     * pemanggil lama sengaja memakainya untuk perintah yang boleh gagal
     * tanpa menghentikan alur (mis. DROP TABLE IF EXISTS). Kalau Anda mau
     * cmdQ() juga melempar exception saat gagal, ganti baris
     * `return $this->result;` di blok catch supaya jadi `throw $e;`.
     */
    public function cmdQ($sqlString) {
      try {
          $queryResource = $this->exec($sqlString);
          if ($queryResource !== false) {
              $this->status = "Success";
              $this->success = "true";
              $this->message = "Perintah SQL berhasil dieksekusi.";
          } else {
              $this->status = "Error";
              $this->success = "false";
              $this->message = "Query Gagal dieksekusi.";
          }
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
          $this->status = "Error";
          $this->success = "false";
          $this->message = "Exception: " . $e->getMessage();
      }

      $this->result = json_encode(array(
          "success" => $this->success ?? "false",
          "status"  => $this->status ?? "Error",
          "message" => $this->message ?? "Unknown error"
      ));
      return $this->result;
    }

    public function getResult() {
        return $this->result;
    }
  }
}

    public function select($jsonName, $table, $fields, $where = null, $order = null, $limit= null, $offset= null, $group = null) {
      $command = 'SELECT '.$fields.' FROM '.$table;
      if($where != null)
        $command .= ' WHERE '.$where;
      if($group != null)
        $command .= ' GROUP BY '.$group;
      if($order != null)
        $command .= ' ORDER BY '.$order;
      if($limit != null)
        $command .= ' LIMIT '.$limit. ' OFFSET '.$offset;

      $query = parent::prepare($command);
      $query->execute();
      $rows = $query->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
      $response = $rows;

      $commandAll = 'SELECT '.$fields.' FROM '.$table;
      if($where != null) $commandAll .= ' WHERE '.$where;
      $queryAll = parent::prepare($commandAll);
      $queryAll->execute();
      $rowsAll = $queryAll->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

      $rowcount = $query->rowCount();
      if($rowcount<=0 && !$query->errorInfo()){
          $errors = $query->errorInfo();
          $result["success"] = "false";
          $result["status"] = "Error";
          $result["message"] = $errors[2];
          $this->result = json_encode($result);
      } else {
        $this->result = "{'totalRecord':'".count($rowsAll)."','".$jsonName."':".json_encode($response)."}";
      }

    }

      $sqlSetUsername = "SET app.username to '".$_SESSION["username"]."'";
      $setUser = parent::prepare($sqlSetUsername);
      $setUser->execute();

      parent::beginTransaction();
      $query = parent::prepare($command);
      $query->execute();

      $rowcount = $query->rowCount();
      if($rowcount <= 0){
        parent::rollback();
        $errors = $query->errorInfo();
        $result["success"] = "false";
        $result["status"] = "Error";
        $result["message"] = $errors[2];
      } else {
        parent::commit();
        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"] = "Success";
        $result["message"] = $rowcount." row(s) updated in database";
      }
      $this->result = json_encode($result);

    /**
     * Helper internal untuk menset session username pada level PostgreSQL Core.
     * Mencegah crash jika session kosong.
     */
    private function setAuditUser() {
      $username = (isset($_SESSION["username"]) && $_SESSION["username"] != '') ? $_SESSION["username"] : 'system';
      $sqlSetUsername = "SET app.username to " . parent::quote($username);
      $setUser = parent::prepare($sqlSetUsername);
      $setUser->execute();
    }

    /*
    * FUNGSI ASLI FRAMEWORK: Insert values into the table
    */
    public function insert($table, $rows = null) {
      $this->setAuditUser();

      $insert = 'INSERT INTO '.$table;
      if($rows != null) {
        $insert .= ' ('.implode(',',array_keys($rows)).')';
        for($i = 0; $i < count($rows); $i++) {
          if(is_string($rows[array_keys($rows)[$i]]))
            $rows[array_keys($rows)[$i]] =	"'".$rows[array_keys($rows)[$i]]."'";
        }
        $insert .= ' VALUES ('.implode(',',array_values($rows)).')';
      }
      $query = parent::prepare($insert);
      $query->execute();
    }

    /*
    * FUNGSI ASLI FRAMEWORK: Delete table or rows
    */
    public function delete($table, $where = null) {
      $this->setAuditUser();

      $delete = 'DELETE FROM '.$table;
      if($where != null) {
        $delete .= ' WHERE '.$where;
      }
      $query = parent::prepare($delete);
      $query->execute();
    }

    /*
    * FUNGSI ASLI FRAMEWORK: Update values inside the table
    */
    public function update($table, $rows, $where) {
      $this->setAuditUser();

      $update = 'UPDATE '.$table.' SET ';
      $keys = array_keys($rows);
      for($i = 0; $i < count($rows); $i++) {
        if(is_string($rows[$keys[$i]])) {
          $update .= $keys[$i].'=\''.$rows[$keys[$i]].'\'';
        } else {
          $update .= $keys[$i].'='.$rows[$keys[$i]];
        }
        if($i != count($rows)-1) {
          $update .= ',';
        }
      }
      $update .= ' WHERE '.$where;
      $query = parent::prepare($update);
      $query->execute();
    }

    /*

    public function select($arg1, $arg2 = '*', $arg3 = null, $arg4 = null, $arg5 = 'data', $arg6 = 0, $arg7 = 250) {

      if ($arg1 === 'data' || $arg1 === 'history') {
          $jsonName = $arg1;
          $table    = $arg2;
          $rows     = $arg3;
          $where    = $arg4;
          $order    = $arg5 !== 'data' ? $arg5 : null;

      if($order != null && trim($order) != '') $q .= ' ORDER BY '.$order;

      $queryAll = parent::prepare($commandAll);
      $queryAll->execute();
      $totalRows = $queryAll->rowCount();

      // Output string JSON murni yang sesuai dengan konfigurasi JsonReader ExtJS
      $this->result = "{'totalRecord':'".$totalRows."','".$jsonName."':".json_encode($response)."}";

    /*
    * FUNGSI ASLI FRAMEWORK: Menjalankan Raw Multi-Query teks lama
    */
    public function cmdQ($command) {
      try {
        $this->setAuditUser();

        parent::beginTransaction();
        $query = parent::prepare($command);
        $query->execute();

        $rowcount = $query->rowCount();
        parent::commit();

        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"] = "Success";
        $result["message"] = $rowcount." row(s) updated in database...";
        $this->result = json_encode($result);
        return true;
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        if (parent::inTransaction()) {
            parent::rollback();
        }
        $result["success"] = "false";
        $result["status"] = "Error";
        $result["message"] = "Gagal memproses data: " . $e->getMessage();
        $this->result = json_encode($result);
        return false;
      }
    }

    /**
     * FITUR TAMBAHAN BARU: Digunakan khusus untuk transaksi aman berbasis parameter terikat (Anti SQL Injection)
     */
    public function safeTransaction($queriesAndParams) {
      try {
        $this->setAuditUser();

        parent::beginTransaction();

        $totalUpdated = 0;
        foreach ($queriesAndParams as $item) {
            $stmt = parent::prepare($item['query']);
            $stmt->execute($item['params']);
            $totalUpdated += $stmt->rowCount();
        }

        parent::commit();

        $result["success"] = "true";
        $result["status"] = "Success";
        $result["message"] = "Data berhasil disimpan.";
        $this->result = json_encode($result);
        return true;
      } catch (PDOException $e) {
        if (parent::inTransaction()) {
            parent::rollback();
        }
        $result["success"] = "false";
        $result["status"] = "Error";
        $result["message"] = "Transaksi Gagal: " . $e->getMessage();
        $this->result = json_encode($result);
        return false;
      }
    }

    public function getResult() {
      return $this->result;
    }

    case 'read':
        $sql = "

                h.bin_location_id, bl.code AS bin_code,
                h.status, h.remark,
                COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_opname_dtl d WHERE d.opname_hdr_id = h.id), 0) AS total_item,
                COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_opname_dtl d WHERE d.opname_hdr_id = h.id AND d.variance_qty != 0), 0) AS total_selisih
            FROM stock_opname_hdr h

        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT d.item_name, ig.name AS grade_name, d.system_qty, d.counted_qty, d.variance_qty
            FROM stock_opname_dtl d
            LEFT JOIN item_grade ig ON ig.id = d.grade_id
            WHERE d.opname_hdr_id = :id
            ORDER BY d.id ASC
        ");
        $stmt->execute(['id' => $opnameId]);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. READ COMBO: Gudang
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_warehouse':
        $sql = "SELECT id, name FROM m_warehouse WHERE active = true ORDER BY name ASC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. READ COMBO: Bin Location per Gudang
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_bin_by_warehouse':
        $warehouseId = intval($_POST['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($warehouseId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
            exit;
        }
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            SELECT id, code, name
            FROM bin_locations
            WHERE warehouse_id = :warehouse_id AND active = true
            ORDER BY code ASC
        ");
        $stmt->execute(['warehouse_id' => $warehouseId]);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. SNAPSHOT: saldo sistem SAAT INI untuk semua item yang punya
    //    saldo != 0 di gudang(+bin) terpilih -- jadi starting point
    //    buat user input hasil hitung fisik.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_stock_snapshot':
        $warehouseId   = intval($_POST['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
        $binLocationId = !empty($_POST['bin_location_id']) ? intval($_POST['bin_location_id']) : null;

        if ($warehouseId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
            exit;
        }

        $sql = "
            SELECT
                sm.item_id, i.name AS item_name, sm.grade_id, ig.name AS grade_name,
                SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type = 'IN' THEN sm.qty ELSE -sm.qty END) AS system_qty
            FROM stock_movements sm
            LEFT JOIN items i ON i.id = sm.item_id
            LEFT JOIN item_grade ig ON ig.id = sm.grade_id
            WHERE sm.warehouse_id = :warehouse_id
              AND sm.bin_location_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM :bin_location_id
            GROUP BY sm.item_id, i.name, sm.grade_id, ig.name
            HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type = 'IN' THEN sm.qty ELSE -sm.qty END) != 0
            ORDER BY i.name ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['warehouse_id' => $warehouseId, 'bin_location_id' => $binLocationId]);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. CREATE
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'create':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $warehouseId   = intval($_POST['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
        $binLocationId = !empty($_POST['bin_location_id']) ? intval($_POST['bin_location_id']) : null;
        $opnameDate    = trim($_POST['opname_date'] ?? '');
        $remark        = trim($_POST['remark'] ?? '');
        $items         = json_decode($_POST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);

        if ($warehouseId <= 0 || empty($opnameDate) || !is_array($items) || count($items) === 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Lengkapi gudang, tanggal, dan minimal 1 item yang dihitung.']);
            exit;
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $opnameNo = CreateRefNo('stock_opname_hdr', 'opname_no', 'SO-OPN');

            DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('stock_opname_hdr', [
                'opname_no'       => $opnameNo,
                'opname_date'     => $opnameDate,
                'warehouse_id'    => $warehouseId,
                'bin_location_id' => $binLocationId,
                'status'          => 'posted',
                'remark'          => $remark,
                'created_by'      => $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null
            ]), 'insert stock_opname_hdr');

            $opnameId = $db->lastInsertId();
            if (!$opnameId) {
                $stmtId = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM stock_opname_hdr WHERE opname_no = :no");
                $stmtId->execute(['no' => $opnameNo]);
                $opnameId = $stmtId->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['id'] ?? 0;
            }

            $totalVariance = InsertOpnameItemsAndAdjust($db, $opnameId, $opnameNo, $opnameDate, $warehouseId, $binLocationId, $items);

            $db->commit();
            $msg = "Stock Opname {$opnameNo} berhasil disimpan.";
            $msg .= $totalVariance > 0 ? " {$totalVariance} item dengan selisih sudah diposting ke Kartu Stok." : " Tidak ada selisih ditemukan.";
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => $msg]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                $db->rollBack();
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal simpan data: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 7. DELETE (reverse adjustment stock movement)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'delete':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmtOld = $db->prepare("SELECT opname_no FROM stock_opname_hdr WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtOld->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $opnameNo = $stmtOld->fetchColumn();
            if (!$opnameNo) {
                throw new Exception("Data opname tidak ditemukan.");
            }

            ReverseStockMovementByReference($db, 'adjustment', $id);

            $stmtDelD = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_opname_dtl WHERE opname_hdr_id = :id");
            $stmtDelD->execute(['id' => $id]);

            $stmtDelH = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_opname_hdr WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtDelH->execute(['id' => $id]);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Stock Opname {$opnameNo} berhasil dihapus & penyesuaian stok dibatalkan."]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                $db->rollBack();
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal menghapus data: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
}

// ==================================================================
// HELPER: InsertOpnameItemsAndAdjust
// Insert semua baris hitung (termasuk yang cocok/tanpa selisih, buat
// audit trail), tapi cuma posting stock_movements ADJUSTMENT untuk
// baris yang ada selisih. Return jumlah baris yang ada selisih.
// ==================================================================
function InsertOpnameItemsAndAdjust($db, $opnameId, $opnameNo, $opnameDate, $warehouseId, $binLocationId, array $items) {
    $varianceCount = 0;

    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $itemId     = intval($it['item_id'] ?? 0);
        $itemName   = trim($it['item_name'] ?? '');
        $gradeId    = !empty($it['grade_id']) ? intval($it['grade_id']) : null;
        $systemQty  = round(floatval($it['system_qty'] ?? 0), 4);
        $countedQty = round(floatval($it['counted_qty'] ?? 0), 4);
        $remark     = trim($it['remark'] ?? '');

        if ($itemId <= 0) {
            continue;
        }

        $variance = round($countedQty - $systemQty, 4);

        DbOrFail($db, $db->insert('stock_opname_dtl', [
            'opname_hdr_id'   => $opnameId,
            'item_id'         => $itemId,
            'item_name'       => $itemName,
            'grade_id'        => $gradeId,
            'bin_location_id' => $binLocationId,
            'system_qty'      => $systemQty,
            'counted_qty'     => $countedQty,
            'variance_qty'    => $variance,
            'remark'          => $remark
        ]), 'insert stock_opname_dtl');

        if (abs($variance) < 0.0001) {
            continue; // cocok, gak perlu movement
        }

        $varianceCount++;

        PostStockMovement($db, [
            'movement_date'   => $opnameDate,
            'item_id'         => $itemId,
            'grade_id'        => $gradeId,
            'warehouse_id'    => $warehouseId,
            'bin_location_id' => $binLocationId,
            'movement_type'   => $variance > 0 ? 'IN' : 'OUT',
            'qty'             => abs($variance),
            'reference_type'  => 'adjustment',
            'reference_id'    => $opnameId,
            'reference_no'    => $opnameNo,
        ]);
    }

    return $varianceCount;
}

## File: ./php-crud/stock.cardCRD.php

<?php
/*
  Document      : Stock Card (Kartu Stok) Monitoring - Backend Controller
  Description   : Laporan saldo & mutasi stok per item + gudang. Read-only,
                   semua dihitung langsung dari stock_movements (satu-satunya
                   sumber kebenaran, sama prinsip dengan deposit_reportCRD.php).
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read_summary';
$db   = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. COMBO: Gudang (+ opsi "Semua Gudang" ditambahkan di client)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_warehouse':
        $sql = "SELECT id, name FROM m_warehouse WHERE active = true ORDER BY name ASC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. COMBO: Item (search remote, supaya tidak load semua item sekaligus)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_item_combo':
        $query = trim($_POST['query'] ?? '');
        $sql = "SELECT id, name FROM items WHERE is_active = true";
        $params = [];
        if ($query !== '') {
            $sql .= " AND name ILIKE :query";
            $params['query'] = '%' . $query . '%';
        }
        $sql .= " ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 50";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. RINGKASAN: saldo per item (+ grade) di gudang terpilih
    //    (warehouse_id = 0 -> semua gudang digabung, via view_stock_balance_total)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_summary':
        $warehouseId = intval($_POST['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
        $onlyNonZero = ($_POST['only_non_zero'] ?? '1') === '1';

        if ($warehouseId > 0) {
            $sql = "
                SELECT
                    vb.item_id, vb.grade_id, i.name AS item_name,
                    vb.warehouse_id, vb.warehouse_name,
                    vb.balance_qty, vb.avg_unit_cost
                FROM view_stock_balance vb
                LEFT JOIN items i ON i.id = vb.item_id
                WHERE vb.warehouse_id = :warehouse_id
                " . ($onlyNonZero ? " AND vb.balance_qty <> 0 " : "") . "
                ORDER BY i.name ASC
            ";
            $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->execute(['warehouse_id' => $warehouseId]);
        } else {
            $sql = "
                SELECT
                    vt.item_id, vt.grade_id, i.name AS item_name,
                    NULL AS warehouse_id, 'Semua Gudang' AS warehouse_name,
                    vt.balance_qty, NULL AS avg_unit_cost
                FROM view_stock_balance_total vt
                LEFT JOIN items i ON i.id = vt.item_id
                WHERE 1=1
                " . ($onlyNonZero ? " AND vt.balance_qty <> 0 " : "") . "
                ORDER BY i.name ASC
            ";
            $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->execute();
        }

        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. DETAIL MUTASI per item (+grade opsional, +warehouse opsional)
    //    warehouse_id = 0 -> gabung semua gudang, running balance dihitung
    //    total lintas gudang (urut tanggal).
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_mutation':
        $itemId      = intval($_POST['item_id'] ?? 0);
        $gradeId     = intval($_POST['grade_id'] ?? 0);
        $warehouseId = intval($_POST['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);

        if ($itemId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
            exit;
        }

        $where = "sm.item_id = :item_id";
        $params = ['item_id' => $itemId];

        if ($gradeId > 0) {
            $where .= " AND sm.grade_id = :grade_id";
            $params['grade_id'] = $gradeId;
        }
        if ($warehouseId > 0) {
            $where .= " AND sm.warehouse_id = :warehouse_id";
            $params['warehouse_id'] = $warehouseId;
        }

        $sql = "
            SELECT
                sm.movement_date, sm.movement_type, sm.qty, sm.unit_cost,
                sm.reference_type, sm.reference_no, sm.remark,
                wh.name AS warehouse_name,
                SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type = 'IN' THEN sm.qty ELSE -sm.qty END)
                    OVER (ORDER BY sm.movement_date ASC, sm.id ASC) AS running_balance
            FROM stock_movements sm
            LEFT JOIN m_warehouse wh ON wh.id = sm.warehouse_id
            WHERE {$where}
            ORDER BY sm.movement_date ASC, sm.id ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
}

## File: ./php-crud/supplier.paymentCRD.php

<?php
/*
  Document      : Supplier Payment - Backend Controller (Full CRUD + AutoPostJournal Engine)
  Called from   : js/purchase_payment.js
  Note          : Pola mengikuti paymentCRD.php (AR) persis, dibalik sisi
                  debit-kreditnya untuk AP:
                    Payment Entry (AR): Debit Kas/Bank (override) / Kredit Piutang
                    Supplier Payment (AP): Debit Hutang Usaha / Kredit Kas/Bank (override)
                  reference_type = 'supplier_payment' (dipakai utk rule AP
                  MAUPUN Advance -- tidak ada enum terpisah spt customer_deposit)
*/
/*
  PERUBAHAN (perbaikan dari versi yang sudah berjalan)
  - create/update/delete kini SATU transaksi (sebelumnya create autocommit: bila jurnal gagal,
    header + item + paid_amount tetap tersimpan dan user melihat error -> retry = pembayaran dobel).
  - validasi server: invoice ada, milik supplier yang dipilih, nominal <= sisa tagihan, tidak dobel.
  - paid_amount dihitung ulang dari supplier_payment_items (bukan +/- manual dengan GREATEST).
  - saldo deposit tidak boleh negatif (hapus/ubah pembayaran yang uang mukanya sudah terpakai ditolak).
  - nomor SPAY & JV satu-transaksi (butuh CreateRefNoDb di function.all.php baru; ada fallback).
  - task baru read_payment_method; task read_* membaca $_REQUEST (POST maupun GET).
*/

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read';
$db   = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // 1. READ (Grid Utama)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read':
        $sql = "
            SELECT p.id, p.payment_no, p.payment_date, p.supplier_id,
                   s.name AS supplier_name,
                   p.account_id, (coa.account_code || ' - ' || coa.account_name) AS account_name,
                   p.payment_method, p.total_amount, COALESCE(p.allocated_amount, 0) AS allocated_amount,
                   COALESCE(p.excess_amount, 0) AS excess_amount,
                   COALESCE(p.deposit_applied, 0) AS deposit_applied,
                   p.reference_no, p.notes
            FROM supplier_payments p
            LEFT JOIN m_suppliers s ON s.id = p.supplier_id
            LEFT JOIN chart_of_accounts coa ON coa.id = p.account_id
            ORDER BY p.payment_date DESC, p.id DESC
            LIMIT 250
        ";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
        break;
// ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1B. READ PAYMENT DETAIL (Alokasi Invoice yang Dibayar)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_payment_detail':

        ";

            LEFT JOIN supplier_payment_items pi ON pi.invoice_id = i.id AND pi.supplier_payment_id = :payment_id
            WHERE i.supplier_id = :supplier_id
              AND i.status = 'posted'
              AND (((COALESCE(i.total_amount, 0) - COALESCE(i.paid_amount, 0)) + COALESCE(pi.amount_paid, 0)) > 0.01 OR pi.id IS NOT NULL)
            ORDER BY i.invoice_date ASC, i.id ASC
        ";

        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['supplier_id' => $supplierId, 'payment_id' => $paymentId, 'payment_id2' => $paymentId]);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);

    // milik supplier ini. Tidak ada tabel ledger baru.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'read_supplier_deposit_balance':

        }
        $balance = GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $supplierId);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'balance' => $balance]);
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. CREATE  (satu transaksi: header + item + paid_amount + jurnal)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'create':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $rawTotal   = str_replace(',', '', $_POST['total_amount'] ?? '0');
        $totalPaid  = round(floatval($rawTotal), 2);
        $depositApplied = round(floatval($_POST['deposit_applied'] ?? 0), 2);
        $supplierId = intval($_POST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
        $accountId  = intval($_POST['account_id'] ?? 0);
        $payDate    = trim($_POST['payment_date'] ?? '');
        $method     = trim($_POST['payment_method'] ?? 'BANK_TRANSFER');
        $refNo      = trim($_POST['reference_no'] ?? '');
        $notes      = trim($_POST['notes'] ?? '');
        $items      = json_decode($_POST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);

        if ($supplierId <= 0 || empty($payDate) || ($totalPaid <= 0 && $depositApplied <= 0)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Lengkapi data pembayaran. Total dibayar atau saldo deposit yang dipakai harus > 0.']);
            exit;
        }
        if ($totalPaid > 0 && $accountId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Pilih akun Kas/Bank sumber dana.']);
            exit;
        }
        $dtChk = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $payDate);
        if (!$dtChk || $dtChk->format('Y-m-d') !== $payDate) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Format Tanggal Bayar tidak valid (harus YYYY-MM-DD).']);
            exit;
        }

        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
            try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            // Serialisasi per supplier: dua pembayaran bersamaan tidak bisa
            // sama-sama memakai saldo deposit / melunasi invoice yang sama.
            SpLockSupplier($db, $supplierId);
            $before = [$supplierId => GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $supplierId)];

            $alloc = SpNormalizeItems($items);
            $allocatedTotal = round(array_sum($alloc), 2);

            if ($depositApplied > 0) {
                $availableDeposit = $before[$supplierId];
                if ($depositApplied > $availableDeposit + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception("Saldo deposit yang dipakai (Rp " . number_format($depositApplied, 2) . ") melebihi saldo tersedia (Rp " . number_format($availableDeposit, 2) . ").");
                }
                if ($depositApplied > $allocatedTotal + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception('Saldo deposit yang dipakai tidak boleh melebihi total alokasi ke invoice.');
                }
            }

            $cashNeeded = round($allocatedTotal - $depositApplied, 2);
            if ($totalPaid + 0.01 < $cashNeeded) {
                throw new Exception("Total dibayar + saldo deposit belum cukup menutupi alokasi invoice.");
            }
            $excessAmount = round($totalPaid - $cashNeeded, 2);

            // invoice ada, milik supplier ini, nominal <= sisa tagihan (baris dikunci)
            SpValidateAllocations($db, $supplierId, $alloc);

            $paymentNo = SpNextRefNo($db, 'supplier_payments', 'payment_no', 'SPAY');

            $createdBy = null;
            $rawUserId = intval($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($rawUserId > 0) {
                $stmtUser = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :uid LIMIT 1");
                $stmtUser->execute(['uid' => $rawUserId]);
                if ($stmtUser->fetchColumn()) {
                    $createdBy = $rawUserId;
                }
            }

            $okHeader = $db->insert('supplier_payments', [
                'payment_no'       => $paymentNo,
                'payment_date'     => $payDate,
                'supplier_id'      => $supplierId,
                'account_id'       => $totalPaid > 0 ? $accountId : null,
                'payment_method'   => $method,
                'total_amount'     => $totalPaid,
                'allocated_amount' => $allocatedTotal,
                'excess_amount'    => $excessAmount,
                'deposit_applied'  => $depositApplied,
                'reference_no'     => $refNo,
                'notes'            => $notes,
                'created_by'       => $createdBy
            ]);
            if ($okHeader === false) {
                throw new Exception('ERROR ASLI DB HEADER: ' . $db->getResult());
            }

            $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM supplier_payments WHERE payment_no = :no ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1");
            $stmtP->execute(['no' => $paymentNo]);
            $paymentId = intval($stmtP->fetchColumn());
            if ($paymentId <= 0) {
                throw new Exception('ERROR ASLI DB HEADER: id pembayaran tidak terbaca setelah insert.');
            }

            foreach ($alloc as $invId => $amt) {
                $okItem = $db->insert('supplier_payment_items', [
                    'supplier_payment_id' => $paymentId,
                    'invoice_id'          => $invId,
                    'amount_paid'         => $amt
                ]);
                if ($okItem === false) {
                    throw new Exception("ERROR ASLI DB ITEM (Invoice ID {$invId}): " . $db->getResult());
                }
            }

            // paid_amount dihitung dari item (sumber kebenaran), bukan ditambah manual
            SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, array_keys($alloc));

            try {
                PostSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $paymentId, $paymentNo, $payDate, $accountId, $allocatedTotal, $excessAmount, $depositApplied);
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                throw new Exception('ERROR ASLI POST JURNAL: ' . $e->getMessage());
            }

            SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, $before);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'id' => $paymentId, 'payment_no' => $paymentNo, 'message' => "Pembayaran {$paymentNo} berhasil disimpan."]);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
            exit;
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. UPDATE
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'update':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $id          = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $supplierId  = intval($_POST['supplier_id'] ?? 0);
        $accountId   = intval($_POST['account_id'] ?? 0);
        $payDate     = trim($_POST['payment_date'] ?? '');
        $method      = trim($_POST['payment_method'] ?? 'BANK_TRANSFER');
        $refNo       = trim($_POST['reference_no'] ?? '');
        $notes       = trim($_POST['notes'] ?? '');
        $items       = json_decode($_POST['arrItems'] ?? '[]', true);

        $rawTotal  = str_replace(',', '', $_POST['total_amount'] ?? '0');
        $totalPaid = round(floatval($rawTotal), 2);
        $depositApplied = round(floatval($_POST['deposit_applied'] ?? 0), 2);

        if ($id <= 0 || $supplierId <= 0 || empty($payDate) || ($totalPaid <= 0 && $depositApplied <= 0)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Data edit tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }
        if ($totalPaid > 0 && $accountId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Pilih akun Kas/Bank sumber dana.']);
            exit;
        }
        $dtChk = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $payDate);
        if (!$dtChk || $dtChk->format('Y-m-d') !== $payDate) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Format Tanggal Bayar tidak valid (harus YYYY-MM-DD).']);
            exit;
        }

        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
            try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmtOldPay = $db->prepare("SELECT payment_no, supplier_id FROM supplier_payments WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtOldPay->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldPay = $stmtOldPay->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$oldPay) {
                throw new Exception("Data pembayaran tidak ditemukan.");
            }
            $oldPayNo       = $oldPay['payment_no'];
            $oldSupplierId  = intval($oldPay['supplier_id']);

            // kunci supplier lama & baru (urut id supaya tidak deadlock) + catat saldo deposit awal
            $sids = array_values(array_unique([$oldSupplierId, $supplierId]));
            sort($sids);
            $before = [];
            foreach ($sids as $sid) {
                SpLockSupplier($db, $sid);
                $before[$sid] = GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $sid);
            }

            $stmtOldItems = $db->prepare("SELECT invoice_id FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtOldItems->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldInvoiceIds = array_map('intval', $stmtOldItems->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN));

            $alloc = SpNormalizeItems($items);
            SpLockInvoices($db, array_merge($oldInvoiceIds, array_keys($alloc)));

            ReverseSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $id);

            $stmtDelItems = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtDelItems->execute(['id' => $id]);

            $allocatedTotal = round(array_sum($alloc), 2);

            if ($depositApplied > 0) {
                // dihitung SETELAH jurnal lama dibalik -> pemakaian deposit oleh pembayaran ini sendiri sudah kembali
                $availableDeposit = GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $supplierId);
                if ($depositApplied > $availableDeposit + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception("Saldo deposit yang dipakai melebihi saldo tersedia (Rp " . number_format($availableDeposit, 2) . ").");
                }
                if ($depositApplied > $allocatedTotal + 0.01) {
                    throw new Exception('Saldo deposit yang dipakai tidak boleh melebihi total alokasi ke invoice.');
                }
            }

            $cashNeeded = round($allocatedTotal - $depositApplied, 2);
            if ($totalPaid + 0.01 < $cashNeeded) {
                throw new Exception('Total dibayar + saldo deposit belum cukup menutupi alokasi invoice.');
            }
            $excessAmount = round($totalPaid - $cashNeeded, 2);

            // item lama sudah dihapus -> "pembayaran lain" saja yang dihitung sebagai terbayar
            SpValidateAllocations($db, $supplierId, $alloc);

            $okUpd = $db->update('supplier_payments', [
                'payment_date'     => $payDate,
                'supplier_id'      => $supplierId,
                'account_id'       => $totalPaid > 0 ? $accountId : null,
                'payment_method'   => $method,
                'total_amount'     => $totalPaid,
                'allocated_amount' => $allocatedTotal,
                'excess_amount'    => $excessAmount,
                'deposit_applied'  => $depositApplied,
                'reference_no'     => $refNo,
                'notes'            => $notes
            ], "id = " . intval($id));

            if ($okUpd === false) {
                throw new Exception("GAGAL UPDATE HEADER: " . $db->getResult());
            }

            foreach ($alloc as $invId => $amt) {
                $okInsItem = $db->insert('supplier_payment_items', ['supplier_payment_id' => $id, 'invoice_id' => $invId, 'amount_paid' => $amt]);
                if ($okInsItem === false) {
                    throw new Exception("GAGAL INSERT ITEM UPDATE (Invoice ID {$invId}): " . $db->getResult());
                }
            }

            SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, array_merge($oldInvoiceIds, array_keys($alloc)));

            PostSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $id, $oldPayNo, $payDate, $accountId, $allocatedTotal, $excessAmount, $depositApplied);

            SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, $before);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Pembayaran {$oldPayNo} berhasil diperbarui."]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ERROR UPDATE: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
            exit;
        }
        break;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. DELETE
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    case 'delete':
        $access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }

        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID data tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        if ($db->inTransaction()) {
            try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
        }

        try {
            $db->beginTransaction();

            $stmtOldPay = $db->prepare("SELECT payment_no, supplier_id FROM supplier_payments WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtOldPay->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldPay = $stmtOldPay->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$oldPay) {
                throw new Exception("Data pembayaran tidak ditemukan.");
            }
            $oldPayNo = $oldPay['payment_no'];
            $delSupplierId = intval($oldPay['supplier_id']);

            SpLockSupplier($db, $delSupplierId);
            $before = [$delSupplierId => GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $delSupplierId)];

            $stmtOldItems = $db->prepare("SELECT invoice_id FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtOldItems->execute(['id' => $id]);
            $oldInvoiceIds = array_map('intval', $stmtOldItems->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN));
            SpLockInvoices($db, $oldInvoiceIds);

            ReverseSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $id);

            $stmtDelItems = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM supplier_payment_items WHERE supplier_payment_id = :id");
            $stmtDelItems->execute(['id' => $id]);

            $stmtDelHeader = $db->prepare("DELETE FROM supplier_payments WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtDelHeader->execute(['id' => $id]);

            SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, $oldInvoiceIds);

            // uang muka dari pembayaran ini mungkin sudah dipakai pembayaran lain
            SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, $before);

            $db->commit();
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Pembayaran {$oldPayNo} berhasil dihapus & jurnal dibatalkan."]);

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                try { $db->rollBack(); } catch (Exception $ex) {}
            }
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ERROR DELETE: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
            exit;
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
}

// ==================================================================
// HELPER LOKAL
// ==================================================================
function PostSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $paymentId, $paymentNo, $payDate, $cashAccountId, $allocatedTotal, $excessAmount, $depositApplied = 0) {
    $cashPortionAp = round($allocatedTotal - $depositApplied, 2);

    // (0) Porsi yang dilunasi pakai saldo deposit di supplier -> Debit
    //     Hutang Usaha (2100, fixed) / Kredit Uang Muka Pembelian (1400,
    //     fixed). Tidak ada akun yang perlu di-override di sini.
    if ($depositApplied > 0) {
        $resultDep = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code'      => 'SUP_PAY_DEP',
            'reference_type' => 'supplier_payment',
            'reference_id'   => $paymentId,
            'journal_date'   => $payDate,
            'amount'         => $depositApplied,
            'description'    => 'Pelunasan Hutang Pakai Deposit ' . $paymentNo,
        ]);
        if (!$resultDep['success']) {
            throw new Exception($resultDep['message']);
        }
    }

    // (1) Porsi yang mengurangi Hutang Usaha pakai kas/bank -> Debit Hutang Usaha (fixed) / Kredit Kas-Bank (override)
    if ($cashPortionAp > 0) {
        $resultAp = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code'         => 'SUP_PAY_AP',
            'reference_type'    => 'supplier_payment',
            'reference_id'      => $paymentId,
            'journal_date'      => $payDate,
            'amount'            => $cashPortionAp,
            'description'       => 'Pembayaran Hutang ' . $paymentNo,
            'credit_account_id' => $cashAccountId, // akun Kas/Bank pilihan user
        ]);
        if (!$resultAp['success']) {
            throw new Exception($resultAp['message']);
        }
    }

    // (2) Porsi lebih bayar -> Debit Uang Muka Pembelian (fixed) / Kredit Kas-Bank (override)
    if ($excessAmount > 0) {
        $resultAdv = AutoPostJournal($db, [
            'rule_code'         => 'SUP_PAY_ADV',
            'reference_type'    => 'supplier_payment',
            'reference_id'      => $paymentId,
            'journal_date'      => $payDate,
            'amount'            => $excessAmount,
            'description'       => 'Uang Muka Pembelian dari Pembayaran ' . $paymentNo,
            'credit_account_id' => $cashAccountId, // akun Kas/Bank pilihan user
        ]);
        if (!$resultAdv['success']) {
            throw new Exception($resultAdv['message']);
        }
    }

    if ($allocatedTotal <= 0 && $excessAmount <= 0 && $depositApplied <= 0) {
        throw new Exception('Tidak ada nominal untuk diposting ke jurnal.');
    }
}

function ReverseSupplierPaymentJournal($db, $paymentId) {
    // Kedua rule (AP & Advance) sama-sama pakai reference_type
    // 'supplier_payment' -- satu panggilan ini menghapus keduanya sekaligus.
    ReverseJournalByReference($db, 'supplier_payment', $paymentId);
}

/*
  Hitung saldo deposit tersedia di seorang supplier, langsung dari
  journal_lines (net debit-kredit akun 1400 Uang Muka Pembelian), dilacak
  lewat reference_type='supplier_payment' + reference_id = id di
  supplier_payments milik supplier ini.
*/
function GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $supplierId) {
    $sql = "
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit - jl.credit), 0) AS balance
        FROM journal_lines jl
        JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_id
        JOIN chart_of_accounts coa ON coa.id = jl.account_id AND coa.account_code = '1400'
        WHERE je.reference_type = 'supplier_payment'
          AND je.reference_id IN (
              SELECT id FROM supplier_payments WHERE supplier_id = :supplier_id
          )
    ";
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    $stmt->execute(['supplier_id' => $supplierId]);
    $balance = floatval($stmt->fetchColumn());
    return round($balance, 2);
}


// ==================================================================
// HELPER TAMBAHAN (validasi server, penguncian, hitung ulang paid_amount)
// ==================================================================

/** Placeholder :p0,:p1,... untuk klausa IN. */
function SpInList(array $ids, $prefix, array &$params) {
    $ph = [];
    foreach (array_values($ids) as $i => $v) {
        $ph[] = ':' . $prefix . $i;
        $params[$prefix . $i] = (int)$v;
    }
    return implode(',', $ph);
}

/** Nomor referensi satu-transaksi (lihat CreateRefNoDb di function.all.php); fallback ke CreateRefNo. */
function SpNextRefNo($db, $table, $column, $prefix) {
    $no = function_exists('CreateRefNoDb')
        ? CreateRefNoDb($db, $table, $column, $prefix)
        : CreateRefNo($table, $column, $prefix);
    if ($no === '' || $no === null) {
        throw new Exception('Gagal generate nomor dokumen (' . $prefix . ').');
    }
    return $no;
}

/** Kunci per supplier selama transaksi (advisory lock, lepas otomatis saat COMMIT/ROLLBACK). */
function SpLockSupplier($db, $supplierId) {
    $supplierId = intval($supplierId);
    if ($supplierId <= 0) { return; }
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7101, CAST(:sid AS integer))");
    $st->execute(['sid' => $supplierId]);
}

/** Baris items dari browser -> [invoice_id => nominal]. Baris kosong dilewati; invoice dobel ditolak. */
function SpNormalizeItems($items) {
    $alloc = [];
    if (!is_array($items)) { return $alloc; }
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $invId = intval($it['invoice_id'] ?? 0);
        $amt   = round(floatval($it['amount_paid'] ?? 0), 2);
        if ($invId <= 0 || $amt <= 0) { continue; }
        if (isset($alloc[$invId])) {
            throw new Exception('Invoice yang sama tidak boleh muncul dua kali dalam satu pembayaran.');
        }
        $alloc[$invId] = $amt;
    }
    return $alloc;
}

/** Kunci baris invoice (urut id). */
function SpLockInvoices($db, array $ids) {
    $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('intval', $ids))));
    if (empty($ids)) { return; }
    sort($ids);
    $params = [];
    $in = SpInList($ids, 'l', $params);
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id FROM purchase_invoice_hdr WHERE id IN ($in) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE");
    $st->execute($params);
}

/**
 * Invoice harus ada, milik supplier yang dipilih, dan nominal <= sisa tagihan.
 * Sisa = total - SUM(item pembayaran yang ada di DB saat ini); pada update, item lama
 * pembayaran ini sudah dihapus lebih dulu, jadi hanya pembayaran LAIN yang dihitung.
 */
function SpValidateAllocations($db, $supplierId, array $alloc) {
    if (empty($alloc)) { return; }
    $ids = array_keys($alloc);
    SpLockInvoices($db, $ids);

    $params = [];
    $in = SpInList($ids, 'v', $params);
    $st = $db->prepare("
        SELECT inv.id, inv.inv_no, inv.supplier_id,
               COALESCE(inv.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
               COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.amount_paid) FROM supplier_payment_items i WHERE i.invoice_id = inv.id), 0) AS paid_now
        FROM purchase_invoice_hdr inv
        WHERE inv.id IN ($in)
    ");
    $st->execute($params);
    $map = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) { $map[intval($r['id'])] = $r; }

    foreach ($alloc as $invId => $amt) {
        if (!isset($map[$invId])) {
            throw new Exception("Invoice (id {$invId}) tidak ditemukan.");
        }
        $r = $map[$invId];
        if (intval($r['supplier_id']) !== intval($supplierId)) {
            throw new Exception("Invoice {$r['inv_no']} milik supplier yang berbeda dengan pembayaran ini.");
        }
        $outstanding = round((float)$r['total_amount'] - (float)$r['paid_now'], 2);
        if ($amt > $outstanding + 0.01) {
            throw new Exception("Pembayaran untuk invoice {$r['inv_no']} (Rp " . number_format($amt, 2) . ") melebihi sisa tagihan (Rp " . number_format($outstanding, 2) . ").");
        }
    }
}

/** paid_amount = SUM(item pembayaran). Idempotent, tidak ada GREATEST(0, ...) yang menyembunyikan selisih. */
function SpRecalcInvoicePaid($db, array $ids) {
    $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('intval', $ids))));
    if (empty($ids)) { return; }
    sort($ids);
    $params = [];
    $in = SpInList($ids, 'r', $params);
    $st = $db->prepare("
        UPDATE purchase_invoice_hdr AS h
           SET paid_amount = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.amount_paid) FROM supplier_payment_items i WHERE i.invoice_id = h.id), 0)
         WHERE h.id IN ($in)
    ");
    $st->execute($params);
}

/**
 * Saldo deposit supplier tidak boleh menjadi negatif akibat operasi ini.
 * $before = [supplier_id => saldo sebelum operasi]. Bila saldo sudah negatif sebelumnya dan
 * tidak bertambah buruk, operasi tetap diizinkan.
 */
function SpAssertDepositNotNegative($db, array $before) {
    foreach ($before as $sid => $b) {
        $after = GetSupplierDepositBalance($db, $sid);
        if ($after < -0.01 && $after < $b - 0.01) {
            throw new Exception("Saldo deposit supplier akan menjadi negatif (Rp " . number_format($after, 2) . "). Uang muka dari pembayaran ini sudah dipakai pembayaran lain -- batalkan/ubah pembayaran yang memakainya terlebih dahulu.");
        }
    }
}

## File: ./php-crud/poCRD.php
