<?php
/*
  Document      : Profit & Loss (Rugi Laba) - CRUD & Report Handler
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/financial_profit_lossCRD.php
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task   = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read_profit_loss';
$access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);
$db     = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ==============================================================
    // READ: Data Periode
    case 'read_periods':
        $sql = "SELECT id, period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods ORDER BY start_date DESC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // READ: Laporan Rugi Laba Utama
    case 'read_profit_loss':
        $periodId = intval($_POST['period_id'] ?? $_REQUEST['period_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($periodId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode akuntansi wajib dipilih.']);
            exit;
        }

        $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
        $stmtP->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
        $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$period) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode tidak ditemukan.']);
            exit;
        }

        $sql = "
            SELECT c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
                   COALESCE(SUM(
                       CASE WHEN c.account_type = 'revenue' THEN l.credit - l.debit
                            WHEN c.account_type = 'expense' THEN l.debit - l.credit
                            ELSE 0 END
                   ), 0) AS amount
            FROM chart_of_accounts c
            LEFT JOIN journal_lines l ON l.account_id = c.id
            LEFT JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
                AND j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')
                AND j.journal_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
            WHERE c.is_active = true
              AND c.account_type IN ('revenue', 'expense')
            GROUP BY c.id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type
            ORDER BY c.account_code ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([
            'start_date' => $period['start_date'],
            'end_date'   => $period['end_date']
        ]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $revenues = [];
        $expenses = [];
        $totalRevenue = 0;
        $totalExpense = 0;

        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $amount = floatval($r['amount']);
            $item = [
                'id'           => $r['id'],
                'account_code' => $r['account_code'],
                'account_name' => $r['account_name'],
                'amount'       => $amount
            ];

            if ($r['account_type'] === 'revenue') {
                $revenues[] = $item;
                $totalRevenue += $amount;
            } else if ($r['account_type'] === 'expense') {
                $expenses[] = $item;
                $totalExpense += $amount;
            }
        }

        $netProfitLoss = $totalRevenue - $totalExpense;

        echo json_encode([
            'success'        => true,
            'period_name'    => $period['period_name'],
            'start_date'     => $period['start_date'],
            'end_date'       => $period['end_date'],
            'revenues'       => $revenues,
            'expenses'       => $expenses,
            'total_revenue'  => $totalRevenue,
            'total_expense'  => $totalExpense,
            'net_profit_loss'=> $netProfitLoss
        ]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // CREATE: Tambah Pemetaan Akun Baru (Pendapatan / Beban)
    case 'create':
        if ($access < 2) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $code = trim($_POST['account_code'] ?? '');
        $name = trim($_POST['account_name'] ?? '');
        $type = trim($_POST['account_type'] ?? '');

        if (empty($code) || empty($name) || !in_array($type, ['revenue', 'expense'])) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Kode, Nama, dan Tipe (revenue/expense) wajib diisi.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->insert('chart_of_accounts', [
            'account_code' => $code,
            'account_name' => $name,
            'account_type' => $type,
            'is_active'    => true
        ]);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun Rugi Laba berhasil ditambahkan.']);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // UPDATE: Update Informasi Akun Rugi Laba
    case 'update':
        if ($access < 3) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id   = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $code = trim($_POST['account_code'] ?? '');
        $name = trim($_POST['account_name'] ?? '');

        if ($id <= 0 || empty($code) || empty($name)) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID, Kode, dan Nama Akun tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->update('chart_of_accounts', [
            'account_code' => $code,
            'account_name' => $name
        ], "id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun Rugi Laba berhasil diperbarui.']);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // DELETE: Soft Delete Akun (Nonaktifkan Akun)
    case 'delete':
        if ($access < 4) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akses ditolak.']);
            exit;
        }
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id <= 0) {
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID Akun tidak valid.']);
            exit;
        }

        $db->update('chart_of_accounts', ['is_active' => false], "id = {$id}");
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Akun berhasil dinonaktifkan.']);
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

## File: ./php-crud/m.materialsCRD.php

<?php
/**
 * m.materialsCRD.php
 * Backend Controller CRUD Master Material (materials) PostgreSQL
 */

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

session_start();
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$task = $_REQUEST['task'] ?? '';

// Helper error handling PostgreSQL
function PgOrFail($result, $context = '') {
    if ($result === false) {
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . pg_last_error());
    }
    return $result;
}

try {
    switch ($task) {

        // ==========================================================
        // 1. LIST -- Load Data Grid
        // ==========================================================
        case 'list':
            $search = trim($_REQUEST['query'] ?? '');
            $where  = '1=1';
            $params = [];

            if ($search !== '') {
                $where .= " AND (material_code ILIKE $1 OR material_name ILIKE $1)";
                $params[] = '%' . $search . '%';
            }

            $sql = "SELECT id, material_code, material_name, unit, estimated_price, active, created_at
                    FROM materials
                    WHERE {$where}
                    ORDER BY material_name ASC";
                    
            $result = PgOrFail(pg_query_params($sql, $params), 'list');
            $rows = pg_fetch_all($result) ?: [];

            foreach ($rows as &$r) {
                $r['active'] = ($r['active'] === 't' || $r['active'] === 'true' || $r['active'] === true);
            }

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $rows]);
            break;

        // ==========================================================
        // 2. READ EDIT -- Load Single Record
        // ==========================================================
        case 'read_edit':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $result = PgOrFail(pg_query_params(
                "SELECT id, material_code, material_name, unit, estimated_price, active
                 FROM materials WHERE id = $1",
                [$id]
            ), 'read_edit');
            
            $row = pg_fetch_assoc($result);
            if (!$row) throw new Exception('Data material tidak ditemukan');

            $row['active'] = ($row['active'] === 't' || $row['active'] === 'true' || $row['active'] === true);

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $row]);
            break;

        // ==========================================================
        // 3. CREATE -- Insert Material Baru
        // ==========================================================
        case 'create':
            $code  = trim($_REQUEST['material_code'] ?? '');
            $name  = trim($_REQUEST['material_name'] ?? '');
            $unit  = trim($_REQUEST['unit'] ?? '');
            $price = (float)($_REQUEST['estimated_price'] ?? 0);

            // Parsing status active
            $rawActive = $_REQUEST['is_active'] ?? 'false';
            $active = ($rawActive === 'true' || $rawActive === 't' || $rawActive === '1' || $rawActive === true || $rawActive === 'on') ? 't' : 'f';

            if ($code === '') throw new Exception('Kode Material wajib diisi');
            if ($name === '') throw new Exception('Nama Material wajib diisi');
            if ($unit === '') throw new Exception('Satuan wajib diisi');

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            try {
                $result = PgOrFail(pg_query_params(
                    "INSERT INTO materials (material_code, material_name, unit, estimated_price, active)
                     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id",
                    [$code, $name, $unit, $price, $active]
                ), 'insert materials');
                
                $newId = pg_fetch_result($result, 0, 'id');
                pg_query('COMMIT');
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                @pg_query('ROLLBACK');
                if (stripos($e->getMessage(), 'duplicate') !== false || stripos($e->getMessage(), 'unique') !== false) {
                    throw new Exception("Kode Material '{$code}' sudah dipakai. Gunakan kode lain.");
                }
                throw $e;
            }

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'id' => $newId, 'material_code' => $code]);
            break;

        // ==========================================================
        // 4. UPDATE -- Perbarui Data Material
        // ==========================================================
        case 'update':
            $id    = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $code  = trim($_REQUEST['material_code'] ?? '');
            $name  = trim($_REQUEST['material_name'] ?? '');
            $unit  = trim($_REQUEST['unit'] ?? '');
            $price = (float)($_REQUEST['estimated_price'] ?? 0);

            // Parsing status active
            $rawActive = $_REQUEST['is_active'] ?? 'false';
            $active = ($rawActive === 'true' || $rawActive === 't' || $rawActive === '1' || $rawActive === true || $rawActive === 'on') ? 't' : 'f';

            if ($id <= 0) throw new Exception('ID Material tidak valid');
            if ($code === '') throw new Exception('Kode Material wajib diisi');
            if ($name === '') throw new Exception('Nama Material wajib diisi');
            if ($unit === '') throw new Exception('Satuan wajib diisi');

            pg_query('BEGIN');
            try {
                PgOrFail(pg_query_params(
                    "UPDATE materials
                     SET material_code = $1, material_name = $2, unit = $3, estimated_price = $4, active = $5
                     WHERE id = $6",
                    [$code, $name, $unit, $price, $active, $id]
                ), 'update materials');
                
                pg_query('COMMIT');
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                @pg_query('ROLLBACK');
                if (stripos($e->getMessage(), 'duplicate') !== false || stripos($e->getMessage(), 'unique') !== false) {
                    throw new Exception("Kode Material '{$code}' sudah dipakai oleh material lain.");
                }
                throw $e;
            }

            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'id' => $id]);
            break;

        // ==========================================================
        // 5. DELETE -- Soft Delete
        // ==========================================================
        case 'delete':
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            if ($id <= 0) throw new Exception('ID Material tidak valid');

            PgOrFail(pg_query_params(
                "UPDATE materials SET active = 'f' WHERE id = $1",
                [$id]
            ), 'soft delete materials');

            echo json_encode(['success' => true]);
            break;

        default:
            throw new Exception('Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task));
    }
} catch (Exception $e) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
}

<?php
// php-crud/dashboardCRD.php
// Semua output DIJAMIN JSON valid (warning/notice PHP tidak lagi merusak respons).
ini_set('display_errors', '0');
ob_start();
header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../cron/fetch_kurs_pajak.php';

function out(array $data, int $flags = 0): void
{
    if (ob_get_length()) {
        ob_clean();
    }
    echo json_encode($data, $flags | JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    out(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Sesi berakhir, silakan login ulang.']);
}

/*
 * Sumber data "Performa Keuangan". Matikan salah satu jika ternyata
 * tabelnya sudah saling mirror (mencegah hitung ganda).
 */
const SRC_FIN_INCOME   = true;  // financial_incomes
const SRC_PRJ_PAYMENT  = true;  // project_payment_items (pembayaran termin klien)
const SRC_FIN_EXPENSE  = true;  // financial_expenses
const SRC_MATERIAL_OUT = true;  // material_out_items x unit_cost (biaya material ke proyek)

$db     = new crud();
$action = $_GET['action'] ?? $_POST['action'] ?? '';

switch ($action) {

    // 1. LIST PROYEK
    case 'get_projects':
        try {
            $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id, name AS project_name FROM projects ORDER BY name ASC");
            $stmt->execute();
            out(['success' => true, 'data' => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)]);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            out(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // 2. KURS PAJAK KMK TERBARU
    case 'read_tax_rates':
        try {
            $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT id, kmk_no, start_date, end_date FROM tax_exchange_rate_hdr ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1");
            $stmt->execute();
            $header = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (!$header) {
                out(['success' => true, 'kmk_number' => '-', 'start_date' => '-', 'end_date' => '-', 'rates' => []]);
            }

            $stmt = $db->prepare("
                SELECT currency_code, currency_name, unit_multiplier, rate, change_amount, change_direction
                FROM tax_exchange_rate_dtl
                WHERE hdr_id = :hdr
                ORDER BY currency_code ASC
            ");
            $stmt->bindValue(':hdr', (int)$header['id'], PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $stmt->execute();

            out([
                'success'    => true,
                'kmk_number' => $header['kmk_no'],
                'start_date' => date('d/m/Y', strtotime($header['start_date'])),
                'end_date'   => date('d/m/Y', strtotime($header['end_date'])),
                'rates'      => $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC),
            ], JSON_NUMERIC_CHECK);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            out(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal membaca kurs pajak: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // 3. SYNC KURS DARI BEA CUKAI
    case 'sync_tax_rates':
        try {
            if (!function_exists('fetchAndStoreTaxExchangeRates')) {
                out(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Fungsi fetchAndStoreTaxExchangeRates tidak ditemukan.']);
            }
            out((array)fetchAndStoreTaxExchangeRates($db));
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            out(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Gagal mengambil data dari server Bea Cukai: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
        break;

    // 4. PERFORMA KEUANGAN (PENDAPATAN VS PENGELUARAN PER BULAN)
    case 'read_financial_performance':
        $year      = isset($_GET['year']) ? (int)$_GET['year'] : (int)date('Y');
        $projectId = (int)($_GET['project_id'] ?? 0);
        $from      = sprintf('%04d-01-01', $year);
        $to        = sprintf('%04d-01-01', $year + 1);

        $params = [];
        $P = function ($v) use (&$params) {
            $k = ':p' . count($params);
            $params[$k] = $v;
            return $k;
        };
        $cancelled = "('VOID','CANCELLED','CANCELED','BATAL')";

        $inc = [];
        $exp = [];

        if (SRC_FIN_INCOME) {
            $inc[] = "SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM income_date)::int AS bln, amount
                      FROM financial_incomes
                      WHERE income_date >= CAST({$P($from)} AS date) AND income_date < CAST({$P($to)} AS date)
                        AND COALESCE(UPPER(status),'') NOT IN {$cancelled}"
                   . ($projectId ? " AND project_id = {$P($projectId)}" : "");
        }
        if (SRC_PRJ_PAYMENT) {
            $inc[] = "SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pp.payment_date)::int AS bln, ppi.amount_paid AS amount
                      FROM project_payment_items ppi
                      JOIN project_payments pp ON pp.id = ppi.payment_id
                      JOIN project_invoices pi ON pi.id = ppi.invoice_id
                      WHERE pp.payment_date >= CAST({$P($from)} AS date) AND pp.payment_date < CAST({$P($to)} AS date)"
                   . ($projectId ? " AND pi.project_id = {$P($projectId)}" : "");
        }
        if (SRC_FIN_EXPENSE) {
            $exp[] = "SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM expense_date)::int AS bln, amount
                      FROM financial_expenses
                      WHERE expense_date >= CAST({$P($from)} AS date) AND expense_date < CAST({$P($to)} AS date)
                        AND COALESCE(UPPER(status),'') NOT IN {$cancelled}"
                   . ($projectId ? " AND project_id = {$P($projectId)}" : "");
        }
        if (SRC_MATERIAL_OUT) {
            $exp[] = "SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM h.issue_date)::int AS bln, (i.qty_out * i.unit_cost) AS amount
                      FROM material_out_items i
                      JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id = i.material_out_id
                      WHERE h.issue_date >= CAST({$P($from)} AS date) AND h.issue_date < CAST({$P($to)} AS date)
                        AND h.status = 'posted' AND h.reversed_at IS NULL"
                   . ($projectId ? " AND h.project_id = {$P($projectId)}" : "");
        }

        $empty  = "SELECT 0::int AS bln, 0::numeric AS amount WHERE false";
        $incSql = $inc ? implode(' UNION ALL ', $inc) : $empty;
        $expSql = $exp ? implode(' UNION ALL ', $exp) : $empty;

        $sql = "
            WITH inc AS ({$incSql}), exp AS ({$expSql})
            SELECT g.bln,
                   (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM inc WHERE inc.bln = g.bln) AS total_inc,
                   (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM exp WHERE exp.bln = g.bln) AS total_exp
            FROM generate_series(1,12) AS g(bln)
            ORDER BY g.bln
        ";

        $pendapatan  = array_fill(0, 12, 0.0);
        $pengeluaran = array_fill(0, 12, 0.0);

        try {
            $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
            foreach ($params as $k => $v) {
                $stmt->bindValue($k, $v, is_int($v) ? PDO::PARAM_INT : PDO::PARAM_STR);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            foreach ($stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $r) {
                $idx = (int)$r['bln'] - 1;
                $pendapatan[$idx]  = (float)$r['total_inc'];
                $pengeluaran[$idx] = (float)$r['total_exp'];
            }
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            // Jangan disembunyikan lagi: kirim error ke frontend agar terlihat.
            error_log('[dashboardCRD] financial_performance: ' . $e->getMessage());
            out(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Query performa keuangan gagal: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }

        $resp = [
            'success'  => true,
            'year'     => $year,
            'labels'   => ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Agu', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des'],
            'datasets' => ['pendapatan' => $pendapatan, 'pengeluaran' => $pengeluaran],
        ];

        // ?debug=1 -> tampilkan jumlah baris tiap sumber (untuk diagnosa "kenapa 0")
        if (!empty($_GET['debug'])) {
            $dbg = [];
            foreach (['financial_incomes', 'project_payment_items', 'financial_expenses', 'material_out_items', 'material_out_header'] as $t) {
                try {
                    $dbg[$t] = (int)$db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {$t}")->fetchColumn();
                } catch (Exception $e) {
                    $dbg[$t] = 'ERR: ' . $e->getMessage();
                }
            }
            $resp['debug'] = $dbg;
        }
        out($resp, JSON_NUMERIC_CHECK);
        break;

    // 5. MONITORING PENYERAPAN MATERIAL (RAB vs MATERIAL OUT) - tanpa view
    case 'read_material_monitoring':
        $projectId = (int)($_GET['project_id'] ?? 0);

        $params = [];
        $P = function ($v) use (&$params) {
            $k = ':p' . count($params);
            $params[$k] = $v;
            return $k;
        };

        // RAB: gabung per (proyek, material). Baris tanpa material_id tetap dihitung (key = -id).
        $budWhere = "(LOWER(b.category) = 'material' OR b.material_id IS NOT NULL)"
                  . ($projectId ? " AND b.project_id = {$P($projectId)}" : "");
        $outWhere = "h.status = 'posted' AND h.reversed_at IS NULL"
                  . ($projectId ? " AND h.project_id = {$P($projectId)}" : "");

        $sql = "
            WITH bud AS (
                SELECT b.project_id,
                       b.material_id,
                       MAX(b.item_name)                       AS item_name,
                       MAX(NULLIF(b.unit,''))                 AS unit,
                       SUM(b.qty_plan)                        AS qty_plan,
                       SUM(b.qty_plan * b.unit_price_plan)    AS budget_value,
                       MAX(b.tolerance_pct)                   AS tolerance_pct
                FROM budget_items b
                WHERE {$budWhere}
                GROUP BY b.project_id, COALESCE(b.material_id, -b.id), b.material_id
            ),
            outs AS (
                SELECT h.project_id,
                       i.material_id,
                       SUM(i.qty_out)                AS qty_out,
                       SUM(i.qty_out * i.unit_cost)  AS out_value
                FROM material_out_items i
                JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id = i.material_out_id
                WHERE {$outWhere}
                GROUP BY h.project_id, i.material_id
            )
            SELECT COALESCE(b.project_id, o.project_id)          AS project_id,
                   COALESCE(b.material_id, o.material_id)        AS material_id,
                   COALESCE(m.material_code, '')                 AS item_code,
                   COALESCE(m.material_name, b.item_name, '(Tanpa nama)') AS item_name,
                   COALESCE(b.unit, NULLIF(m.unit,''), '')       AS unit,
                   COALESCE(b.qty_plan, 0)                       AS budget_qty,
                   COALESCE(b.budget_value, 0)                   AS budget_value,
                   COALESCE(b.tolerance_pct, 0)                  AS tolerance_pct,
                   COALESCE(o.qty_out, 0)                        AS out_qty,
                   COALESCE(o.out_value, 0)                      AS out_value
            FROM bud b
            FULL OUTER JOIN outs o
                   ON o.project_id = b.project_id AND o.material_id = b.material_id
            LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.id = COALESCE(b.material_id, o.material_id)
            ORDER BY item_name ASC
        ";

        try {
            $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
            foreach ($params as $k => $v) {
                $stmt->bindValue($k, $v, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            error_log('[dashboardCRD] material_monitoring: ' . $e->getMessage());
            out(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Query monitoring material gagal: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }

        $kpi    = ['budget_rab' => 0.0, 'material_out' => 0.0, 'sisa_budget' => 0.0, 'persentase' => 0.0];
        $counts = ['ON_TRACK' => 0, 'WARNING' => 0, 'OVERBUDGET' => 0];
        $items  = [];

        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $plan  = (float)$r['budget_qty'];
            $used  = (float)$r['out_qty'];
            $tol   = (float)$r['tolerance_pct'];
            $noRab = $plan <= 0;

            $kpi['budget_rab']   += (float)$r['budget_value'];
            $kpi['material_out'] += (float)$r['out_value'];

            $usage = $noRab ? ($used > 0 ? 100.0 : 0.0) : ($used / $plan) * 100;

            if ($noRab && $used > 0)                 $status = 'OVERBUDGET';   // keluar tanpa RAB
            elseif ($used > $plan * (1 + $tol / 100)) $status = 'OVERBUDGET';
            elseif ($usage >= 80)                    $status = 'WARNING';
            else                                     $status = 'ON_TRACK';

            $counts[$status]++;

            $items[] = [
                'item_code'     => $r['item_code'],
                'item_name'     => $r['item_name'],
                'unit'          => $r['unit'],
                'budget_qty'    => $plan,
                'budget_value'  => (float)$r['budget_value'],
                'out_qty'       => $used,
                'out_value'     => (float)$r['out_value'],
                'remaining_qty' => $plan - $used,
                'usage_pct'     => round($usage, 1),
                'no_rab'        => $noRab,
                'status'        => $status,
            ];
        }

        usort($items, fn($a, $b) => $b['usage_pct'] <=> $a['usage_pct']);

        $kpi['sisa_budget'] = $kpi['budget_rab'] - $kpi['material_out'];
        $kpi['persentase']  = $kpi['budget_rab'] > 0 ? round($kpi['material_out'] / $kpi['budget_rab'] * 100, 2) : 0.0;

        out(['success' => true, 'kpi' => $kpi, 'status_counts' => $counts, 'items' => $items], JSON_NUMERIC_CHECK);
        break;

    default:
        out(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Aksi tidak ditemukan']);
}

$db   = new crud(); // [FIX] sebelumnya tidak ada -- inilah penyebab "Aksi tidak valid" / fatal

function PrepOrFailMP($stmt, $context = '') {
    if ($stmt === false) {
        throw new Exception(($context ? "[{$context}] " : '') . 'Query gagal dijalankan.');
    }
    return $stmt;
}
function mpFetchAll($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailMP($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
}
function mpFetchOne($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailMP($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    return $row === false ? null : $row;
}
function mpExec($db, $sql, array $params = [], $ctx = '') {
    $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
    PrepOrFailMP($stmt, $ctx);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt;
}

$access = intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0);

try {
    switch ($task) {

        case 'read':
            $sql = "SELECT p.id, p.name, p.client_id, c.name AS client_name,
                           p.pic_id, pic.name AS pic_name,
                           p.location_id, loc.name AS location_name, p.location,
                           p.start_date, p.end_date, p.budget, p.contract_value, p.spent, p.progress,
                           p.status, p.notes
                    FROM projects p
                    LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id
                    LEFT JOIN pics pic ON pic.id = p.pic_id
                    LEFT JOIN m_location loc ON loc.id = p.location_id
                    ORDER BY p.id DESC";
            $data = mpFetchAll($db, $sql, [], 'read');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'totalCount' => count($data), 'data' => $data]);
            break;

        case 'read_one':

            $row = mpFetchOne($db, "SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = :id", ['id' => $id], 'read_one');

                "SELECT id, name FROM clients ORDER BY name", [], 'read_clients')]);

        case 'read_pics':

                "SELECT id, name FROM m_location ORDER BY name", [], 'read_locations')]);

        case 'update':
            if ($task === 'create' && $access < 2) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menambah proyek.']);
                exit;
            }
            if ($task === 'update' && $access < 3) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengubah proyek.']);
                exit;
            }

            $id             = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            $name           = trim($_REQUEST['name'] ?? '');
            $client_id      = ($_REQUEST['client_id'] ?? '') !== '' ? (int)$_REQUEST['client_id'] : null;
            $pic_id         = ($_REQUEST['pic_id'] ?? '') !== '' ? (int)$_REQUEST['pic_id'] : null;
            $location_id    = ($_REQUEST['location_id'] ?? '') !== '' ? (int)$_REQUEST['location_id'] : null;
            $start_date     = $_REQUEST['start_date'] ?: null;
            $end_date       = $_REQUEST['end_date'] ?: null;
            $budget         = (float)($_REQUEST['budget'] ?? 0);
            $contract_value = (float)($_REQUEST['contract_value'] ?? 0);
            $progress       = (int)($_REQUEST['progress'] ?? 0);
            $status         = $_REQUEST['status'] ?? 'Berjalan';
            $notes          = $_REQUEST['notes'] ?? '';

            if ($name === '') throw new Exception('Nama Proyek wajib diisi.');
            if (!in_array($status, ['Belum Mulai', 'Berjalan', 'Tertunda', 'Selesai'], true)) {
                throw new Exception('Status proyek tidak valid.');
            }
            if ($progress < 0 || $progress > 100) throw new Exception('Progress harus antara 0-100.');
            if ($end_date && $start_date && $end_date < $start_date) {
                throw new Exception('Tanggal Selesai tidak boleh sebelum Tanggal Mulai.');
            }
            if ($budget < 0 || $contract_value < 0) throw new Exception('Budget/Nilai Kontrak tidak boleh negatif.');

            if ($task === 'create') {
                $newId = (int)mpFetchOne($db,
                    "INSERT INTO projects
                        (name, client_id, pic_id, location_id, start_date, end_date, budget, contract_value, progress, status, notes, created_at, updated_at)
                     VALUES (:name, :cid, :pid, :lid, :sd, :ed, :budget, :cv, :progress, :status, :notes, NOW(), NOW())
                     RETURNING id",
                    ['name' => $name, 'cid' => $client_id, 'pid' => $pic_id, 'lid' => $location_id,
                     'sd' => $start_date, 'ed' => $end_date, 'budget' => $budget, 'cv' => $contract_value,
                     'progress' => $progress, 'status' => $status, 'notes' => $notes],
                    'insert projects')['id'];
                echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'id' => $newId, 'message' => "Proyek '{$name}' berhasil ditambahkan."]);
            } else {
                if (!$id) throw new Exception('ID proyek tidak valid.');
                mpExec($db,
                    "UPDATE projects SET
                        name = :name, client_id = :cid, pic_id = :pid, location_id = :lid,
                        start_date = :sd, end_date = :ed, budget = :budget, contract_value = :cv,
                        progress = :progress, status = :status, notes = :notes, updated_at = NOW()

                     'sd' => $start_date, 'ed' => $end_date, 'budget' => $budget, 'cv' => $contract_value,
                     'progress' => $progress, 'status' => $status, 'notes' => $notes, 'id' => $id],
                    'update projects');
                echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => "Proyek '{$name}' berhasil diperbarui."]);
            }
            break;

        case 'delete':
            if ($access < 4) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus proyek.']);
                exit;
            }
            $id = (int)($_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);
            if (!$id) throw new Exception('ID proyek tidak valid.');

            $refs = mpFetchOne($db,
                "SELECT
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders WHERE project_id = :id) AS po_count,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_invoices WHERE project_id = :id) AS termin_count,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_out_header WHERE project_id = :id) AS mout_count",
                ['id' => $id], 'cek referensi proyek');
            $refCount = (int)$refs['po_count'] + (int)$refs['termin_count'] + (int)$refs['mout_count'];
            if ($refCount > 0) {
                throw new Exception("Proyek ini tidak bisa dihapus karena sudah punya transaksi terkait (PO: {$refs['po_count']}, Termin: {$refs['termin_count']}, Pemakaian Material: {$refs['mout_count']}).");
            }

            mpExec($db, "DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = :id", ['id' => $id], 'delete projects');
            echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Proyek berhasil dihapus.']);
            break;

        default:
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali.']);
            break;
    }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage() !== '' ? $e->getMessage() : 'Terjadi kesalahan pada server.']);

## File: ./php-crud/warehouse.issuingCRD.php
----------------------------------------
<?php
/**
 * warehouse.issuingCRD.php
 * ============================================================
 * Backend Controller Warehouse Issuing (Material Out ke proyek) - warehouse.issuing.js
 * Pola sama dengan rabCRD.php: PDO (class crud), dispatch lewat $_REQUEST['task'],
 * respons JSON {success, message, data, totalCount}.
 *
 * Aturan bisnis:
 *  1. Issue hanya dari stok yang sudah di-RCV (wh_receiving_dtl, posted, belum reversed).
 *  2. Qty issue per material tidak boleh > sisa layer RCV di gudang tsb
 *     (sisa = qty RCV - retur pembelian posted - issue posted lain).
 *  3. Setiap issue wajib punya proyek tujuan (material_out_header.project_id).
 *  4. Nilai issue = biaya layer RCV yang diambil, urut FIFO (received_date, id).
 *     Jejak per layer disimpan di material_issue_allocations; total per baris di material_out_items.amount.
 *  5. Melebihi RAB / material tanpa RAB boleh, tapi wajib isi alasan overbudget.
 *  6. Issue posted tidak diedit; dibatalkan lewat reverse_issue (layer FIFO pulih otomatis).
 *
 * Butuh: sql/2026-09-30.warehouse_issuing.sql
 * ============================================================
 */

ini_set('display_errors', '0');
ob_start();

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$db = new crud();

const GI_EPS = 0.00005;

class GiBusinessError extends Exception {}

function sendJsonResponse($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $response = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        if (is_array($data) && isset($data['data'])) {
            $response['data'] = $data['data'];
            if (isset($data['totalCount'])) $response['totalCount'] = $data['totalCount'];
        } else {
            $response['data'] = $data;
        }
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($response, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function gi_num(array $row, array $keys): array {
    foreach ($keys as $k) {
        if (array_key_exists($k, $row)) $row[$k] = (float)$row[$k];
    }
    return $row;
}

function gi_fmt($n): string {
    return rtrim(rtrim(number_format((float)$n, 4, '.', ''), '0'), '.');
}

/** Query dasar layer FIFO. Parameter: :wh (warehouse_id). Pemanggil menambah filter item/ORDER/FOR UPDATE. */
function gi_layer_sql(): string {
    return "
        SELECT d.id AS layer_id, d.item_id, d.grade_id, d.lot_no,
               d.unit_cost AS unit_cost,
               h.ref_no AS rcv_ref, h.received_date, h.id AS hdr_id,
               (d.qty_received - COALESCE(ret.q, 0) - COALESCE(al.q, 0)) AS remaining
          FROM wh_receiving_dtl d
          JOIN wh_receiving_hdr h ON h.id = d.wh_receiving_hdr_id
          LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT rd.wh_receiving_dtl_id AS id, SUM(rd.qty_returned) AS q
                  FROM purchase_return_dtl rd
                  JOIN purchase_return_hdr rh ON rh.id = rd.return_hdr_id
                 WHERE rh.status = 'posted'
                 GROUP BY rd.wh_receiving_dtl_id
          ) ret ON ret.id = d.id
          LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT a.layer_id AS id, SUM(a.qty) AS q
                  FROM material_issue_allocations a
                  JOIN material_out_items  i  ON i.id  = a.out_item_id
                  JOIN material_out_header oh ON oh.id = i.material_out_id
                 WHERE a.layer_source = 'WHRCV' AND oh.status = 'posted' AND oh.reversed_at IS NULL
                 GROUP BY a.layer_id
          ) al ON al.id = d.id
         WHERE h.warehouse_id = :wh AND h.status = 'posted' AND h.reversed_at IS NULL";
}

/** Layer FIFO (yang masih ada sisa) satu material di satu gudang, tertua dulu. */
function gi_layers($db, int $wh, int $item, bool $lock = false): array {
    $sql = gi_layer_sql() . " AND d.item_id = :item
            ORDER BY h.received_date ASC, h.id ASC, d.id ASC" . ($lock ? " FOR UPDATE OF d" : "");
    $st = $db->prepare($sql);
    $st->execute([':wh' => $wh, ':item' => $item]);
    $out = [];
    foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $l) {
        $l['remaining'] = (float)$l['remaining'];
        $l['unit_cost'] = (float)$l['unit_cost'];
        if ($l['remaining'] > GI_EPS) $out[] = $l;
    }
    return $out;
}

/** Alokasi FIFO. Return ['allocs','amount','available']. */
function gi_allocate(array $layers, float $qty): array {
    $available = 0.0;
    foreach ($layers as $l) $available += $l['remaining'];

    $need = $qty; $allocs = []; $amount = 0.0;
    foreach ($layers as $l) {
        if ($need <= GI_EPS) break;
        $take = min($l['remaining'], $need);
        $amt  = round($take * $l['unit_cost'], 2);
        $allocs[] = [
            'layer_id' => (int)$l['layer_id'], 'grade_id' => $l['grade_id'], 'lot_no' => $l['lot_no'],
            'rcv_ref' => $l['rcv_ref'], 'received_date' => $l['received_date'],
            'qty' => round($take, 4), 'unit_cost' => $l['unit_cost'], 'amount' => $amt,
        ];
        $amount += $amt;
        $need   -= $take;
    }
    return ['allocs' => $allocs, 'amount' => round($amount, 2), 'available' => round($available, 4)];
}

/** RAB proyek untuk satu material + pemakaian posted. */
function gi_budget($db, int $project, int $mat): array {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_plan),0) AS plan, COALESCE(MAX(tolerance_pct),0) AS tol, COUNT(*) AS n
                          FROM budget_items WHERE project_id = :p AND material_id = :m");
    $st->execute([':p' => $project, ':m' => $mat]);
    $b = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty_out),0)
                          FROM material_out_items i
                          JOIN material_out_header h ON h.id = i.material_out_id
                         WHERE h.project_id = :p AND i.material_id = :m AND h.status = 'posted' AND h.reversed_at IS NULL");
    $st->execute([':p' => $project, ':m' => $mat]);
    $used = (float)$st->fetchColumn();

    $plan = (float)$b['plan'];
    return ['has_rab' => (int)$b['n'] > 0, 'limit' => $plan * (1 + (float)$b['tol'] / 100), 'used' => $used];
}

                  LEFT JOIN wh_receiving_dtl d ON d.id = a.layer_id
                  LEFT JOIN wh_receiving_hdr h ON h.id = d.wh_receiving_hdr_id
                 WHERE a.out_item_id IN (SELECT id FROM material_out_items WHERE material_out_id = :id)
                 ORDER BY a.id");
            $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
            $byItem = [];
            foreach ($st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $a) {
                $byItem[$a['out_item_id']][] = gi_num($a, ['qty', 'unit_cost', 'amount']);
            }
            foreach ($items as &$it) {
                $it = gi_num($it, ['qty_out', 'unit_cost', 'amount']);
                $it['is_overbudget'] = ($it['is_overbudget'] === true || $it['is_overbudget'] === 't' || $it['is_overbudget'] === '1');
                $it['allocations'] = $byItem[$it['id']] ?? [];
            }
            sendJsonResponse(true, ['header' => $hdr, 'items' => $items]);
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * POST ISSUE
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'save_issue':
            $prj   = (int)($_POST['project_id'] ?? 0);
            $wh    = (int)($_POST['warehouse_id'] ?? 0);
            $date  = (string)($_POST['issue_date'] ?? '');
            $items = json_decode($_POST['items'] ?? '[]', true);

            try {
                $d = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $date);
                if (!$d || $d->format('Y-m-d') !== $date) throw new GiBusinessError('Tanggal issue tidak valid.');
                if ($prj <= 0) throw new GiBusinessError('Proyek tujuan wajib dipilih.');
                if ($wh <= 0)  throw new GiBusinessError('Gudang wajib dipilih.');
                if (!is_array($items) || !count($items)) throw new GiBusinessError('Minimal satu material harus di-issue.');

                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.projects WHERE id = :id");
                $st->execute([':id' => $prj]);
                if (!$st->fetchColumn()) throw new GiBusinessError('Proyek tidak ditemukan.');

                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.warehouses WHERE id = :id AND active IS TRUE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $wh]);
                if (!$st->fetchColumn()) throw new GiBusinessError('Gudang tidak ditemukan / tidak aktif.');

                if (!function_exists('CreateRefNo')) throw new Exception('CreateRefNo() tidak tersedia.');
                $ref = CreateRefNo('material_out_header', 'ref_no', 'GI');

                $db->beginTransaction();
                try {
                    $st = $db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO material_out_header
                            (ref_no, project_id, warehouse_id, issue_date, issued_by, received_by_mandor, status, remark)
                        VALUES (:ref, :prj, :wh, CAST(:dt AS date), :uid, :mandor, 'posted', :remark)
                        RETURNING id");
                    $st->execute([
                        ':ref' => $ref, ':prj' => $prj, ':wh' => $wh, ':dt' => $date, ':uid' => $userId,
                        ':mandor' => trim((string)($_POST['received_by_mandor'] ?? '')) ?: null,
                        ':remark' => trim((string)($_POST['remark'] ?? '')) ?: null,
                    ]);
                    $hid = (int)$st->fetchColumn();

                    $stMat  = $db->prepare("SELECT material_name, COALESCE(unit,'') AS unit FROM public.materials WHERE id = :id");
                    $stItem = $db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO material_out_items
                            (material_out_id, material_id, qty_out, unit_cost, amount, lot_no, is_overbudget, overbudget_reason, notes)
                        VALUES (:hid, :mat, :qty, :cost, :amt, :lot, :over, :reason, :notes)
                        RETURNING id");
                    $stAlloc = $db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO material_issue_allocations (out_item_id, layer_source, layer_id, qty, unit_cost, amount)
                        VALUES (:iid, 'WHRCV', :layer, :qty, :cost, :amt)");
                    $stMove = $db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO stock_movements
                            (movement_date, item_id, grade_id, warehouse_id, movement_type, qty, unit_cost,
                             reference_type, reference_id, reference_no, remark, created_by)
                        VALUES (CAST(:dt AS date), :item, :grade, :wh, 'OUT', :qty, :cost,
                                'MATERIAL_OUT', :hid, :ref, :remark, :uid)");

                    $grand = 0.0;
                    foreach ($items as $n => $it) {
                        $mat = (int)($it['material_id'] ?? 0);
                        $qty = round((float)($it['qty'] ?? 0), 4);
                        $no  = 'Baris ' . ($n + 1);
                        if ($mat <= 0 || $qty <= 0) throw new GiBusinessError("{$no}: material dan qty (> 0) wajib diisi.");

                        $stMat->execute([':id' => $mat]);
                        $mrow = $stMat->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                        if (!$mrow) throw new GiBusinessError("{$no}: material tidak ditemukan.");
                        $label = $mrow['material_name'];

                        // Qty issue <= sisa RCV (layer dikunci; baris sebelumnya di dokumen ini sudah tercatat)
                        $alloc = gi_allocate(gi_layers($db, $wh, $mat, true), $qty);
                        if ($qty > $alloc['available'] + GI_EPS) {
                            throw new GiBusinessError(
                                "{$label}: qty issue " . gi_fmt($qty) . " {$mrow['unit']} melebihi stok hasil RCV di gudang ini (tersedia " .
                                gi_fmt($alloc['available']) . ")."
                            );
                        }

                        // Overbudget terhadap RAB proyek
                        $bud    = gi_budget($db, $prj, $mat);
                        $over   = !$bud['has_rab'] || ($bud['used'] + $qty > $bud['limit'] + GI_EPS);
                        $reason = trim((string)($it['overbudget_reason'] ?? ''));
                        if ($over && $reason === '') {
                            throw new GiBusinessError($label . ': ' . ($bud['has_rab']
                                ? 'melebihi RAB proyek, alasan overbudget wajib diisi.'
                                : 'material tidak ada di RAB proyek, alasan overbudget wajib diisi.'));
                        }

                        $lots = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_column($alloc['allocs'], 'lot_no'))));
                        $stItem->execute([
                            ':hid' => $hid, ':mat' => $mat, ':qty' => $qty,
                            ':cost' => round($alloc['amount'] / $qty, 2), ':amt' => $alloc['amount'],
                            ':lot' => $lots ? substr(implode(',', $lots), 0, 50) : null,
                            ':over' => $over ? 't' : 'f',
                            ':reason' => $over ? substr($reason, 0, 100) : null,
                            ':notes' => trim((string)($it['notes'] ?? '')) ?: null,
                        ]);
                        $iid = (int)$stItem->fetchColumn();

                        foreach ($alloc['allocs'] as $a) {
                            $stAlloc->execute([':iid' => $iid, ':layer' => $a['layer_id'], ':qty' => $a['qty'],
                                               ':cost' => $a['unit_cost'], ':amt' => $a['amount']]);
                            $stMove->execute([
                                ':dt' => $date, ':item' => $mat, ':grade' => $a['grade_id'] ?: null, ':wh' => $wh,
                                ':qty' => $a['qty'], ':cost' => $a['unit_cost'], ':hid' => $hid, ':ref' => $ref,
                                ':remark' => 'Issue ke proyek #' . $prj . ' (FIFO dari ' . $a['rcv_ref'] . ')',
                                ':uid' => $userId,
                            ]);
                        }
                        $grand += $alloc['amount'];
                    }

                    $db->commit();
                    sendJsonResponse(true, ['id' => $hid, 'ref_no' => $ref, 'amount' => round($grand, 2)], "Issue {$ref} berhasil diposting.");
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                    throw $e;
                }
            } catch (GiBusinessError $e) {
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            }
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * REVERSE ISSUE
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'reverse_issue':
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $db->beginTransaction();
            try {
                $st = $db->prepare("SELECT id, ref_no, status FROM material_out_header WHERE id = :id FOR UPDATE");
                $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
                $h = $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$h) throw new GiBusinessError('Dokumen issue tidak ditemukan.');
                if ($h['status'] !== 'posted') throw new GiBusinessError('Dokumen sudah dibatalkan sebelumnya.');

                $st = $db->prepare("UPDATE material_out_header SET status = 'reversed', reversed_at = NOW(), reversed_by = :uid WHERE id = :id");
                $st->execute([':uid' => $userId, ':id' => $id]);

                // Stok kembali: ledger IN pembalik. Layer FIFO pulih otomatis (issue reversed tidak dihitung lagi).
                $st = $db->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO stock_movements
                        (movement_date, item_id, grade_id, warehouse_id, movement_type, qty, unit_cost,
                         reference_type, reference_id, reference_no, remark, created_by)
                    SELECT CURRENT_DATE, item_id, grade_id, warehouse_id, 'IN', qty, unit_cost,
                           'MATERIAL_OUT_REV', reference_id, reference_no, :remark, :uid
                      FROM stock_movements
                     WHERE reference_type = 'MATERIAL_OUT' AND reference_id = :id AND movement_type = 'OUT'");
                $st->execute([':remark' => 'Reverse issue ' . $h['ref_no'], ':uid' => $userId, ':id' => $id]);

                $db->commit();
                sendJsonResponse(true, [], 'Issue ' . $h['ref_no'] . ' dibatalkan, stok dikembalikan.');
            } catch (GiBusinessError $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], $e->getMessage());
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if ($db->inTransaction()) { $db->rollBack(); }
                throw $e;
            }
            break;

        default:
            sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[warehouse.issuingCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[warehouse.issuingCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

## File: ./php-crud/generalledgerCRD.php
----------------------------------------
<?php
/*
  Document      : General Ledger - Report Handler
  Called from   : js/m.generalledger.js
  Note          : - Laporan read-only, TIDAK ada create/update/delete.
                  - Filter Akun & Periode OPSIONAL:
                      account_id kosong/0 -> tampilkan SEMUA akun (dikelompokkan)
                      period_id  kosong/0 -> tampilkan SEMUA histori (tanpa
                                             batas tanggal, saldo awal = 0)
                  - Hanya jurnal berstatus 'posted' ATAU 'reversed' yang
                    dihitung. Mencakup SEMUA reference_type.
                  - Saldo berjalan dihitung PER AKUN pakai window function
                    (PARTITION BY account_id), ditambah saldo awal per akun
                    (0 kalau periode tidak difilter).
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
    exit;
}

$task = $_POST['task'] ?? $_REQUEST['task'] ?? 'read_ledger';
$db   = new crud();

switch ($task) {

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_accounts':
        $sql = "SELECT id, account_code, account_name, account_type
                FROM chart_of_accounts
                WHERE is_active = true
                ORDER BY account_code ASC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    case 'read_periods':
        $sql = "SELECT id, period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods ORDER BY start_date DESC";
        $stmt = $db->query($sql);
        $data = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    // Laporan utama -- filter account_id & period_id keduanya OPSIONAL
    case 'read_ledger':
        $accountId = intval($_POST['account_id'] ?? 0);
        $periodId  = intval($_POST['period_id'] ?? 0);

        $startDate = null;
        $endDate   = null;
        $periodName = 'Semua Periode';

        if ($periodId > 0) {
            $stmtP = $db->prepare("SELECT period_name, start_date, end_date FROM accounting_periods WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtP->execute(['id' => $periodId]);
            $period = $stmtP->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$period) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Periode tidak ditemukan.']);
                exit;
            }
            $startDate  = $period['start_date'];
            $endDate    = $period['end_date'];
            $periodName = $period['period_name'];
        }

        $accountLabel = 'Semua Akun';
        if ($accountId > 0) {
            $stmtAcc = $db->prepare("SELECT account_code, account_name FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtAcc->execute(['id' => $accountId]);
            $acc = $stmtAcc->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$acc) {
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Akun tidak ditemukan.']);
                exit;
            }
            $accountLabel = $acc['account_code'] . ' - ' . $acc['account_name'];
        }

        // Bangun kondisi WHERE secara dinamis
        $conds  = ["j.status IN ('posted', 'reversed')"];
        $params = [];
        if ($accountId > 0) {
            $conds[] = "l.account_id = :acc";
            $params['acc'] = $accountId;
        }
        if ($startDate !== null) {
            $conds[] = "j.journal_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date";
            $params['start_date'] = $startDate;
            $params['end_date']   = $endDate;
        }
        $where = implode(' AND ', $conds);

        // Saldo awal per akun -- hanya relevan kalau periode difilter.
        // Kalau tidak difilter, seluruh histori sudah masuk ke query utama,
        // jadi saldo awal = 0 (tidak ada "sebelum" yang perlu diakumulasi).
        $openingSubquery = "0";
        if ($startDate !== null) {
            $openingCond = "l2.account_id = l.account_id AND j2.status IN ('posted','reversed') AND j2.journal_date < :ob_start_date";
            if ($accountId > 0) {
                $openingCond .= " AND l2.account_id = :ob_acc";
            }
            $openingSubquery = "(
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c2.account_type IN ('asset','expense') THEN l2.debit - l2.credit ELSE l2.credit - l2.debit END), 0)
                FROM journal_lines l2
                JOIN journal_entries j2 ON j2.id = l2.journal_id
                JOIN chart_of_accounts c2 ON c2.id = l2.account_id
                WHERE {$openingCond}
            )";
            $params['ob_start_date'] = $startDate;
            if ($accountId > 0) $params['ob_acc'] = $accountId;
        }

        $sql = "
            SELECT j.journal_date, j.ref_no, l.description AS line_desc, j.description AS header_desc,
                   l.debit, l.credit, l.account_id, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_type,
                   {$openingSubquery} AS opening_balance,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN c.account_type IN ('asset','expense') THEN l.debit - l.credit ELSE l.credit - l.debit END)
                     OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY j.journal_date, j.id, l.id
                           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_in_range
            FROM journal_lines l
            JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id = l.journal_id
            JOIN chart_of_accounts c ON c.id = l.account_id
            WHERE {$where}
            ORDER BY c.account_code ASC, j.journal_date ASC, j.id ASC, l.id ASC
        ";

        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $data = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $data[] = [
                'account_id'      => $r['account_id'],
                'account_code'    => $r['account_code'],
                'account_name'    => $r['account_name'],
                'account_label'   => $r['account_code'] . ' - ' . $r['account_name'],
                'journal_date'    => $r['journal_date'],
                'ref_no'      => $r['ref_no'],
                'description'     => $r['line_desc'] ?: $r['header_desc'],
                'debit'           => floatval($r['debit']),
                'credit'          => floatval($r['credit']),
                'balance'         => floatval($r['opening_balance']) + floatval($r['cum_in_range'])
            ];
        }

        echo json_encode([
            'success'      => true,
            'account_label'=> $accountLabel,
            'period_name'  => $periodName,
            'totalCount'   => count($data),
            'data'         => $data
        ]);
        break;

    // ==============================================================
    default:
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Task tidak dikenali: ' . htmlspecialchars($task)]);
}

if (!isset($_SESSION)) {
    session_start();

$searchField = $_POST["query"] ?? $_REQUEST["query"] ?? '';
$offset      = isset($_POST["start"]) ? intval($_POST["start"]) : 0;

$dataArray     = json2Array($itemInfoParam);

    // ==========================================
    case ("read_edit"):
        $id = intval($_POST['id'] ?? $_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);

        }

        $db->select($table, $field, $where, $orderBy);
        $result = $db->getResult();
        
        if (empty($result) || trim($result) == "") {
            echo json_encode(array("totalRecord" => 0, "data" => array()));
        } else {
            echo $result;
        }
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 5. CREATE (Tambah User Baru)
    // ==========================================
    case ('create'):
    case ('add'):

        // Validasi Foreign Key Karyawan
        if ($employeeId <= 0) {
            echo json_encode([

                "status"  => "Error", 
                "message" => "Gagal: Pilih Karyawan (Name) yang valid terlebih dahulu!"
            ]);
            exit;
        }

        $queryC = '';
        $table  = "m_user_system";
        $data   = array(
            "login_name"  => checksinglequote($_POST["login_name"] ?? ''),
            "employee_id" => $employeeId,
            "password"    => EncodeData($_POST["password"] ?? ''),
            "active"      => ($_POST["u_active"] === 'true' || $_POST["active"] === 'true') ? 'true' : 'false'
        );
        $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";

        $table = "m_user_login_status";
        $data  = array("user_id" => "currval('m_user_system_id_seq'::regclass)");
        $queryC .= insertQ($table, $data) . ";";

        // Insert Detail Hak Akses Menu (baris dari gridEditor saat New User)
        $formAccessPayload = $_POST['form_access'] ?? $_POST['arrForm'] ?? null;

        if (!empty($formAccessPayload)) {
            // Bersihkan quote escape dari ExtJS
            $cleanJson = stripslashes($formAccessPayload);
            $dataForm  = json_decode($cleanJson, true);

            if (is_array($dataForm) && count($dataForm) > 0) {
                foreach ($dataForm as $row) {
                    $formId    = intval($row['form_id'] ?? 0);
                    $accessLvl = intval($row['access_level'] ?? 1);

                    if ($formId > 0) {
                        $tableD = "m_user_access_menu";
                        $dataD  = array(
                            "user_id"      => "currval('m_user_system_id_seq'::regclass)",
                            "form_id"      => $formId,
                            "access_level" => $accessLvl
                        );
                        $queryC .= insertQ($tableD, $dataD) . ";";
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $db->cmdQ($queryC);
        echo $db->getResult();
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 6. UPDATE (Simpan Header User & Detail Hak Akses)
    // ==========================================
    case ('update'):
    case ('edit'):
        $queryC = '';
        $userId = intval($_POST['user_id'] ?? $_POST['id'] ?? 0);
        $employeeId = intval($_POST["employee_id"] ?? $_POST["name"] ?? 0);

        if ($userId > 0) {
            // Proteksi Fallback: Ambil employee_id dari DB jika nilainya 0
            if ($employeeId <= 0) {
                $checkStmt = $db->prepare("SELECT employee_id FROM m_user_system WHERE id = :id");
                $checkStmt->execute(['id' => $userId]);
                $existRow = $checkStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if ($existRow && !empty($existRow['employee_id'])) {
                    $employeeId = intval($existRow['employee_id']);
                }
            }

            if ($employeeId <= 0) {
                echo json_encode([
                    "success" => "false", 
                    "status"  => "Error", 
                    "message" => "Gagal Simpan: ID Karyawan tidak terdeteksi (Foreign Key Violation)."
                ]);
                exit;
            }

            // A. Update Master Header User System
            $table = "m_user_system";
            $data  = array(
                "login_name"  => checksinglequote($_POST["login_name"] ?? ''),
                "employee_id" => $employeeId,
                "active"      => ($_POST["u_active"] === 'true' || $_POST["u_active"] === true || $_POST["active"] === 'true') ? 'true' : 'false'
            );
            
            if (!empty($_POST["password"])) {
                $data["password"] = EncodeData($_POST["password"]);
            }

            $where = "id = " . $userId;
            $queryC .= updateQ($table, $data, $where) . ";";

            // B. Update / Insert Detail Hak Akses Menu
            $formAccessPayload = $_POST['form_access'] ?? $_POST['arrForm'] ?? null;

            if (!empty($formAccessPayload)) {
                // Bersihkan quote escape dari ExtJS
                $cleanJson = stripslashes($formAccessPayload);
                $dataForm  = json_decode($cleanJson, true);

                if (is_array($dataForm) && count($dataForm) > 0) {
                    $keepAccessIds = array();

                    foreach ($dataForm as $row) {
                        $accessId  = intval($row['id'] ?? 0);
                        $formId    = intval($row['form_id'] ?? 0);
                        $accessLvl = intval($row['access_level'] ?? 1);

                        if ($accessId > 0) {
                            // Update Detail Hak Akses Eksisting
                            $keepAccessIds[] = $accessId;
                            $tableD = "m_user_access_menu";
                            $dataD  = array("access_level" => $accessLvl);
                            $whereD = "id = " . $accessId;
                            $queryC .= updateQ($tableD, $dataD, $whereD) . ";";
                        } else if ($formId > 0) {
                            // Insert Detail Hak Akses Baru
                            // PENTING: dieksekusi langsung (di luar batch $queryC) dengan RETURNING id,
                            // supaya id barunya diketahui dan bisa dimasukkan ke $keepAccessIds SEBELUM
                            // statement DELETE cleanup di bawah dibangun. Kalau tidak, baris baru ini
                            // akan langsung ikut terhapus oleh DELETE ... id NOT IN (...) pada batch yang sama.
                            $insStmt = $db->prepare(
                                "INSERT INTO m_user_access_menu (user_id, form_id, access_level) VALUES (:uid, :fid, :lvl) RETURNING id"
                            );
                            $insStmt->execute([
                                'uid' => $userId,
                                'fid' => $formId,
                                'lvl' => $accessLvl
                            ]);
                            $newAccessId = $insStmt->fetchColumn();
                            if ($newAccessId) {
                                $keepAccessIds[] = intval($newAccessId);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Hapus Detail Menu yang Dibuang/Dihapus pada Grid Editor
                    if (!empty($keepAccessIds)) {
                        $idsString = implode(',', $keepAccessIds);
                        $queryC .= "DELETE FROM m_user_access_menu WHERE user_id = " . $userId . " AND id NOT IN (" . $idsString . ");";
                    }
                }
            }

            $db->cmdQ($queryC);
            echo $db->getResult();
        } else {
            echo json_encode([
                "success" => "false", 
                "status"  => "Error", 
                "message" => "ID User tidak valid untuk proses update."
            ]);
        }
        break;

    // ==========================================
    // 7. DELETE (Hapus User System)
    // ==========================================
    case ('delete'):
        $deleteId = intval($_POST['id'] ?? $_REQUEST['id'] ?? 0);

        if ($deleteId > 0) {
            $table  = "m_user_system";
            $data   = array("active" => 'false');
            $where  = "id = " . $deleteId;
            $queryC = updateQ($table, $data, $where) . ";";

            $db->cmdQ($queryC);
            echo $db->getResult();
        } else {
            echo json_encode([
                "success" => "false", 
                "status"  => "Error", 
                "message" => "ID User tidak valid untuk proses penghapusan."
            ]);
        }
        break;

    default:
        echo json_encode([
            "success" => "false", 
            "status"  => "Error", 
            "message" => "Perintah task '" . htmlspecialchars($task) . "' tidak valid."
        ]);
        break;
}
?>

const SET_MAX_PIXEL    = 4000;
const SET_RATE_TYPES   = ['KMK', 'BI', 'MANUAL'];
const SET_RATE_BASIS   = ['TRANSACTION', 'AVERAGE', 'PERIOD_END'];
const SET_LOGO_COLS    = ['document' => 'logo_document', 'app' => 'logo_app'];     // whitelist nama kolom
const SET_LOGO_MIMES   = ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'];

class SetBusinessError extends Exception {}

function sendJsonResponse($success, $data = [], $message = '', $extra = []) {
    $response = array_merge(['success' => $success, 'message' => $message], $extra);
    if ($success) {
        $response['data'] = $data;
    }
    if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
    echo json_encode($response, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    exit;
}

function set_bool($v): bool {
    return $v === true || $v === 't' || $v === '1' || $v === 1;
}

function set_require_write(): void {
    if (intval($_SESSION['FormAccess'] ?? 0) < SET_ACCESS_WRITE) {
        sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengubah pengaturan.');
    }
}

function set_text($key, int $max, bool $required = false, string $label = ''): ?string {
    $v = trim((string)($_POST[$key] ?? ''));
    if ($required && $v === '') throw new SetBusinessError(($label ?: $key) . ' wajib diisi.');
    if (mb_strlen($v) > $max) throw new SetBusinessError(($label ?: $key) . " maksimal {$max} karakter.");
    return $v === '' ? null : $v;
}

/** Alasan mata uang dasar tidak boleh diganti (null = masih boleh). */
function set_base_lock_reason($db): ?string {
    $checks = [
        'journal_entries'    => 'jurnal',
        'stock_movements'    => 'pergerakan stok',
        'purchase_orders'    => 'PO',
        'supplier_payments'  => 'pembayaran supplier',
        'project_invoices'   => 'invoice proyek',
    ];
    foreach ($checks as $table => $label) {
        $reg = $db->query("SELECT to_regclass('public.{$table}')")->fetchColumn();
        if (!$reg) continue;
        if ((int)$db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.{$table}")->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            return "Sudah ada transaksi ({$label}).";
        }
    }
    return null;
}

function set_currency_exists($db, int $id): bool {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM public.m_currency WHERE id = :id");
    $st->execute([':id' => $id]);
    return (bool)$st->fetchColumn();
}

$userId = (int)$_SESSION['user_id'];

                $ctry  = set_text('country', 100);
                $phone = set_text('phone', 50);
                $email = set_text('email', 150);

                if ($email !== null && !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {

                     phone, email, website, tax_id, updated_by)

                if ($month < 1 || $month > 12)                      throw new SetBusinessError('Bulan awal tahun fiskal harus 1-12.');

                sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Format logo harus PNG, JPEG, atau WEBP.');
            }
            $info = @getimagesize($f['tmp_name']);
            if (!$info) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'File bukan gambar yang valid.');
            if ($info[0] > SET_MAX_PIXEL || $info[1] > SET_MAX_PIXEL) {
                sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Dimensi logo maksimal ' . SET_MAX_PIXEL . ' x ' . SET_MAX_PIXEL . ' piksel.');
            }

            $db->exec("INSERT INTO public.company_profile (id) VALUES (1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING");
            $fp = fopen($f['tmp_name'], 'rb');
            $st = $db->prepare("UPDATE public.company_profile
                                   SET {$col} = :img, {$col}_mime = :mime, {$col}_updated_at = NOW(),
                                       updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = :uid
                                 WHERE id = 1");
            $st->bindParam(':img', $fp, PDO::PARAM_LOB);
            $st->bindValue(':mime', $mime);
            $st->bindValue(':uid', $userId, PDO::PARAM_INT);
            $st->execute();
            fclose($fp);
            sendJsonResponse(true, [], 'Logo berhasil diunggah.');
            break;

        case 'delete_logo':
            set_require_write();
            $type = (string)($_POST['type'] ?? '');
            if (!isset(SET_LOGO_COLS[$type])) sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Jenis logo tidak dikenal.');
            $col = SET_LOGO_COLS[$type];
            $db->prepare("UPDATE public.company_profile
                             SET {$col} = NULL, {$col}_mime = NULL, {$col}_updated_at = NOW(),
                                 updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = :uid WHERE id = 1")
               ->execute([':uid' => $userId]);
            sendJsonResponse(true, [], 'Logo dihapus.');
            break;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
         * Alirkan gambar logo (GET ?task=logo&type=document|app&v=...)
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        case 'logo':
            $type = (string)($_GET['type'] ?? '');
            if (!isset(SET_LOGO_COLS[$type])) { http_response_code(404); if (ob_get_length()) ob_clean(); exit; }
            $col = SET_LOGO_COLS[$type];

            $st = $db->prepare("SELECT {$col}, {$col}_mime FROM public.company_profile WHERE id = 1");
            $st->execute();
            $st->bindColumn(1, $img, PDO::PARAM_LOB);
            $st->bindColumn(2, $mime);
            if (!$st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_BOUND) || $img === null) {
                http_response_code(404);
                if (ob_get_length()) ob_clean();
                exit;
            }
            $bin = is_resource($img) ? stream_get_contents($img) : $img;
            if (is_string($bin) && strncmp($bin, '\\x', 2) === 0) {           // bytea format hex (jaga-jaga)
                $bin = hex2bin(substr($bin, 2));
            }
            if (!in_array($mime, SET_LOGO_MIMES, true) || $bin === '' || $bin === false) {
                http_response_code(404);
                if (ob_get_length()) ob_clean();
                exit;
            }
            if (ob_get_length()) { ob_clean(); }
            header('Content-Type: ' . $mime);
            header('Content-Length: ' . strlen($bin));
            header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
            header('Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400');
            echo $bin;
            exit;

        default:
            sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Aksi/Task tidak dikenal.');
            break;
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log('[settingsCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    if ($task === 'logo') { http_response_code(500); if (ob_get_length()) ob_clean(); exit; }
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[settingsCRD] ' . $e->getMessage());
    if ($task === 'logo') { http_response_code(500); if (ob_get_length()) ob_clean(); exit; }
    sendJsonResponse(false, [], 'System Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}

<?php
/*
  Document      : Balance Sheet (Neraca) - CRUD & Report Handler
  Backend       : /proyek/php-crud/financial_balance_sheetCRD.php
*/
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) { session_start(); }

require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-func/function.all.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../php-class/crudClass.php';

if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"]) || empty($_SESSION["user_id"])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(["success" => false, "message" => "Session expired. Silakan login kembali."]);
